edict_anti_borg_tooltip_fail:
Minimal Policy Allows 1 Edict 

Moderate Policy Allows 2 Edicts 

Aggressive Policy allows all Edicts
edict_edict_advanced_spy_network_desc: Our espionage departments work tirelessly to give our forces a vital edge on the galactic scene, by giving them the additional resources they crave boosts their potential.
edict_edict_anti_borg_adaptation_desc: Increases the chance that our ships will successfully remodulate their weapons when the Borg attempt to adapt against them.
edict_edict_anti_borg_analysis_desc: Significantly reduces the time required for our ships to remodulate their weapons if the Borg manage to adapt against them.
edict_edict_anti_borg_assimilation_desc: Greatly reduces the ability of Borg drones to invade and assimilate our vessels.
edict_edict_anti_borg_tooltip_fail: £ Empire policy cannot support additional Anti-Borg Edicts
edict_edict_architectural_renaissance_de: Massive investments in architecture ensure that all our planetary building construction projects and megastructures receive the most attention, improving the speeds at which they are built.
edict_edict_borg_defensive_ship_building: Increases ship construction speed for a short period of time.
edict_edict_borg_mass_assimilation_desc: Reduces passive £ Unity production to enable assimilation of additional pops per month.
edict_edict_capacity_overload_borg_desc: Additional processing power will be redirected to power processing and gathering, ensuring optimal energy production.
edict_edict_capacity_overload_desc: Allows short-term overloading of regional grids, letting local power plants run at increased capacity.
edict_edict_capacity_overload_machine_de: Additional processing power will be redirected to power processing and gathering, ensuring optimal energy production.
edict_edict_conscription_campaign_desc: Puts into place a national draft where personnel with the skills to become crew members are pressed into active service.
edict_edict_counter_esp_1_desc: Provides a boost to our tireless security services attempting to keep us safe from foreign agents.
edict_edict_counter_esp_2_desc: Ensures that our espionage services actively attempt to prevent threats to our security by actively deploying anti espionage and counterintelligence plans.
edict_edict_counter_esp_3_desc: Apply tight internal security and counterintelligence methods to ensure that our security is given top priority.
edict_edict_counter_esp_4_desc: Operate a security state to prevent information getting into the wrong hands, civil liberties take a backseat to ensuring we maintain our internal security.
edict_edict_declare_saint_desc: Public edicts encourage our people to pick up the old religious texts again and join together with the unity that can only be found in the spiritual world, bringing our people closer together.
edict_edict_defensive_ship_building_desc: When defending our empire from an aggressive force all efforts should be put into defending our borders.
edict_edict_desperate_measures_desc: Will give us direct control over key industries and factories. Our military will want for nothing as we guide the materials and workforce to our war industry.
edict_edict_diplomatic_grants_desc: This encourages collaborations which allow different cultures from around the galaxy to come together to share their ideas and experiences, ensuring a rich cultural collaboration and improving the happiness of other species.
edict_edict_dominion_shipbuilding_desc: The mighty shipyards of the Dominion can be put in overdrive thanks to the motivated efforts of the loyal Jem'Hadar.
edict_edict_early_warning_desc: Sets up small sensor buoys across the system to increase the sensor range of this system to give early warning of enemy fleets.
edict_edict_early_warning_machine_desc: This protocol sets up small sensor buoys across the system to increase the sensor range of this system to give early warning of enemy fleets.
edict_edict_education_campaign_desc: Reforms to our educational policies ensure that our best and brightest rise to the top leadership positions.
edict_edict_education_campaign_machine_d: Supporting the most effective drones with improved processing priority and supplies allows those drones to adapt more rapidly.
edict_edict_encourage_free_thought_desc: Encourages the populace to always challenge conventional wisdom, even if the path taken may lead them astray.
edict_edict_farming_subsidies_borg_desc: Additional processing power will be redirected to bio-nutrient harvesting and growth, ensuring optimum harvests.
edict_edict_farming_subsidies_desc: Provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.
edict_edict_farming_subsidies_machine_de: Additional processing power will be redirected to bio-nutrient harvesting and growth, ensuring optimum harvests.
edict_edict_farming_subsidies_nomad_desc: Provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.
edict_edict_fc_union_desc: The galaxy is full of potential first contact scenarios, by dedicating effort in our diplomatic teams we boost our chances.
edict_edict_feed_the_fire_desc: Our efforts to tame the impure require increased resource production. Increased food production will fuel increase ship building speed.
edict_edict_fleet_focus_desc: Whether its to explore new worlds or subdue our enemies, this edict puts our fleets wellbeing front and centre.
edict_edict_fortress_proclamation_desc: A large investment towards improving and upgrading our defensive starbases across the galaxy.
edict_edict_fortress_proclamation_machin: A large investment towards improving and upgrading our defensive starbases across the galaxy.
edict_edict_grand_fleet_desc: Puts the pride and glory of the Empire's Grand Fleet above all else, and that considerable political capital should be spent ensuring its continued prosperity.
edict_edict_healthcare_campaign_desc: Reforms across our healthcare platforms ensures our population is healthy and fruitful.
edict_edict_information_quarantine_desc: Puts strict checks on the flow of information, better preserving local cultural identities.
edict_edict_infrastructure_revitilizatio: A massive revitalisation and modernisation of our older construction facilities ensures that buildings can be constructed more efficiently and cheaply.
edict_edict_land_of_opportunity_desc: Creates targeted PR campaigns that frame the planet as being on the cutting edge, a new social frontier - a place where anyone can thrive and make a fresh start.
edict_edict_local_festival_1_desc: First Contact Day is the celebration of the iconic first contact between warp pioneer Zefram Cochrane and the Vulcan ship the T'Plana-Hath. It is one of the defining moments in Human history, eventually paving the way for a unified world government.
edict_edict_local_festival_2_desc: Kot'baval is a great annual celebration, marking the glorious victory of Kahless the Unforgettable's glorious victory over the evil Molor in single combat. It is customary for warriors from all over the Empire to take part in the reenactment of this glorious battle.
edict_edict_local_festival_3_desc: Kal Rekk is a day of atonement, solitude and silence, celebrating key and important values of Vulcan Philosophy.
edict_edict_local_festival_4_desc: The Peldor Gratitude Festival is an important event for our people, dating back as far as 17600 BCE. The smell of burning Bateret leaves will fill the streets of every Bajoran planet, worries and troubles will be burnt away through the burning of renewal scrolls. Peldor joi!
edict_edict_local_festival_5_desc: Prixin is a time for family. Lasting multiple days, our Prixin Celebration is a joyful and happy time. We gather on these day to extol the warmth and joy of those unshakable bonds. Without them we could not call ourselves complete. On this day we are thankful to be together.
edict_edict_local_festival_6_desc: Eitreih'hveinn is the honoring of domestic produce. On this day, only priest-sanctioned food can be eaten.
edict_edict_local_festival_7_desc: In order to distract our population from the woes of everyday life, this edict will provide plentiful food and spectacles to keep the population entertained.
edict_edict_local_festival_8_desc: Mother's Day is a celebration honoring the mother of the family, as well as motherhood, maternal bonds, and the influence of mothers in society.
edict_edict_local_festival_9_desc: A tradition going back to the foundation of the Confederation, whereby a grand ceremony is held to celebrate the execution of dissidents, alien sympathizers, and terrorists.
edict_edict_map_the_stars_desc: Pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.
edict_edict_naval_revitalization_desc: A massive revitalisation of our shipyards and construction facilities ensures the most up to date practices and training are undertaken, reducing the cost of producing vessels.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_borg_desc: The activation of this protocol diverts the Collectives £ Unity resources towards the production of additional drones.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_desc: Noting the need for additional officers, allows for the fast tracking of more officers via our academies.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_machine_de: Activating this subroutine promotes the creaton of more units capable of crewing our vessels.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_undine_des: Focusing our efforts on increasing the rate at which we spawn our leaders results in an increase in officer production.
edict_edict_omnifarious_acquisition_desc: Our economic policy is not fit for purpose in this new age. We must correct our taxes and trade laws to ensure they are suitable for a modern nation.
edict_edict_peace_festivals_desc: A festival to celebrate and show our species' history and culture, creating joy and happiness to all involved.
edict_edict_production_targets_atypical_: The focused attention of the entire world will be dedicated to productivity.
edict_edict_production_targets_borg_desc: Additional processing power will be redirected to mineral processing and refinement procedures, ensuring optimal ore production.
edict_edict_production_targets_desc: Focuses our administrative effort to reprioritise and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.
edict_edict_production_targets_machine_d: Additional processing power will be redirected to mineral processing and refinement procedures, ensuring optimal ore production.
edict_edict_production_targets_und_desc: Focuses our administrative effort to reprioritise and re-evaluate production goals, boosting our production means.
edict_edict_push_ufp_formation: Form the United Federation of Planets
edict_edict_push_ufp_formation_desc: A dream that became a reality and spread throughout the stars.
edict_edict_recovery_protocols_borg_2_de: The collective has been damaged, revert primary operations to restoring control.
edict_edict_recovery_protocols_borg_desc: The collective has been damaged, revert primary operations to restoring control.
edict_edict_recycling_campaign_desc: Mass recycling and ecological awareness campaigns are undertaken to ensure our population is mindful of what they consume and waste, leading to a reduction in consumer good consumption.
edict_edict_recycling_campaign_machine_d: Large-scale repair programmes are put underway to ensure drones are operating at peak efficiency and older more inefficient drones are retired. This will reduce the impact on goods required to ensure optimal circumstances.
edict_edict_research_focus_2_desc: We provide subsidies and incentives for students undertaking core science, engineering and mathematical classes to provide the core technologies that a burgeoning interstellar race requires.
edict_edict_research_focus_desc: Allows discounts for students studying science, technology, engineering or mathematics, the most important courses of a space civilisation.
edict_edict_research_footing_desc: Will give improved control over our research branches. Our scientists will be provided with a large support staff and high quality equipment.
edict_edict_share_burden_campaign_desc: Enforces rotating tasks and work schedules for indentured servants, as more varied drudgery can lead to an uptick in productivity.
edict_edict_share_burden_country_desc: Enforces rotating tasks and work schedules for indentured servants, as more varied drudgery can lead to an uptick in productivity.
edict_edict_spy_counter_borg_desc: Establishes internal security subroutines and counter measures to ensure the collectives cyber defenses remain unbreached.
edict_edict_spy_counter_undine_desc: The impure must not get hold of our secrets, locking this knowledge down is the only means of keeping it safe.
edict_edict_spy_network_borg_desc: Activating this protocol will boost the collectives abilities to infiltrate the collectives targets computer systems.
edict_edict_spy_network_desc: The art of espionage is as old as the first civilisations on our homeworld. Increasing our efforts to uncover the secrets of our neighbours will only benefit us.
edict_edict_spy_network_undine_desc: The impure hold secrets, and this cannot remain withheld from us. Boost resources to our spies and capture their secrets.
edict_edict_the_weak_shall_perish_desc: The time has come to drive out the impure and dominate the galaxy. The weak shall perish and the strong shall triumph.
edict_edict_ufp_union_desc: The galaxy is full of potential first contact scenarios, by dedicating effort in our diplomatic teams we boost our chances.
edict_edict_undine_conscription_campaign: Puts into place a national draft where personnel with the skills to become crew members are called to answer the call of the Fluidic Space.
edict_edict_undine_research_focus_desc: Will give improved control over our research branches. Our scientists will be provided with a large support staff and high quality equipment.
edict_edict_undine_vanguard_desc: Set in motion a chain of events that will set the Undine Vanguard loose onto the galaxy.
edict_edict_war_drone_campaign_desc: Puts into place a national service programme where our civilians learn the basics of a disciplined and military life, thus ensuring high standards in our armies.
edict_edict_war_drone_campaign_machine_d: This protocol allows planetary combat drones to take priority over normal processing capacity, improving their adaptability.
edict_edict_war_undine_campaign_desc: Puts into place a drive to build up our armies and fleets to support our war efforts.
edict_edict_will_to_power_desc: We must capture the hearts and minds of our people. Our policies can be adapted to give the people what they think they want.
edict_edict_zhat_vash_desc: Shows active support for the secret organisation, the Zhat Vash, and their mission. Activating the edict will allow additional support and opportunities for this organisation.
edict_push_ufp_formation_effect: Push the formation of the United Federation of Planets, should you have previously decided against forming the UFP or wish to speed up the process.
edict_undine_vanguard_effect: Trigger the events that kick start the Undine invasion of the Milky Way.
ethic_ancient_gestalt_consciousness_desc:
PRIMARY PROTOCOL ACTIVE.
Mission parameters set.
ethic_cybernetic_consensus_desc: Every voice heard, every opinion valid. Our pairs come to a mutually beneficial consensus for the greater good.
ethic_fanatic_collectivist_desc: Cel jednostki jest prosty - wzmacniać zbiorowość. Aby pokonać czerń przestrzeni kosmicznej, musimy pozostać zjednoczeni i nie możemy osłabiać się swawolnym separatyzmem.
ethic_fanatic_genocidal_desc: Any foreign presence must be ruthlessly eradicated. It is not sufficient to merely remove the presence of the foreigner from our midsts, we must seek it out actively and remove it from the universe, before it corrupts the very stars.
ethic_genocidal_desc: Any foreign presence must be ruthlessly eradicated. It is not sufficient to merely remove the presence of the foreigner from our midsts, we must seek it out actively and remove it from the universe, before it corrupts the very stars.
ethic_great_link_desc: We no longer try to explain to outsiders the majesty of our link. A merging of form and thought, the sharing of idea and sensation. In the face of this kind of unity, old divisions and rivalries are forgotten.
ethic_psionic_consensus_desc: Every voice heard, every opinion valid. Our minds come to a mutually beneficial consensus for the greater good.
ethic_superiority_desc: Our civilisation thrives as a result of our natural abilities which far exceed lesser species. Our superiority is demonstrate in all we are.
job_Vaharai_desc: Those Kelpiens who are Vaharai have earned the greatest honour amongst their people, to be chosen by the Watchful Eye to maintain the Great Balance.
job_abbot_desc: Leading the population on religious worlds, Abbots often have a large amount of influence.
job_administrator_ACA_desc: The leaders of the great Acamarian clans are their chiefs, capable of leading vast swathes of the population.
job_administrator_BAJ_desc: Vedeks are powerful religious figures who shepherd Bajoran society. The Vedek Assembly is the governing body of the Bajoran religion and holds great political influence as well.
job_administrator_BET_desc: The keepers of the ancient Betazoid artifacts hold a special place within Betazoid society.
job_administrator_BRU_desc: The genetic engineering of crops and plants is shepherded by the chief botanists of Brunali society. Administering everything from the correct temperature to the allocation of workers to each field, the chief botanists ensure Brunali society flourishes.
job_administrator_BYN_desc: Those pairs who are offered the position of programmer are those highly skilled Bynars whom are the only ones who can touch the inner workings of the Central Computer.
job_administrator_CAR_desc: The chief magistrates of the Cardassian management team are known as Archons.
job_administrator_FEN_desc: The religious leaders of the Fen Domar control and lead the population via their theological means.
job_administrator_FER_desc: A Sub-nagus is the Ferengi title for a person in charge of a particular district or sector.
job_administrator_HIR_desc: Capable of leading vast packs of Hunters, an Alpha Hunter is a feared and powerful warrior.
job_administrator_HUR_desc: The curation of biological species is of vital importance to the insectoid Hur'Q minds. Those Hur'Q with the mind to learn from the exhibits are generally great administrators.
job_administrator_KAZ_desc: Each Maje is a leader of Kazon, a title gained through power.
job_administrator_KRE_desc: Those who can understand temporal mechanics are rare, and are offered a special place amongst the Krenim who seek to use the timestream for their own gain.
job_administrator_NAU_desc: Pirate chiefs organise raiding parties and robberies across large swathes of space.
job_administrator_RAK_desc: An Exarch is a powerful post holder within the Rakhari.
job_administrator_ROM_desc: A senator is a powerful elected official who is a member of a legislative body known as the Romulan Senate. They usually represent well-populated provinces or even entire planets.
job_administrator_SHE_desc: The importance of protocol ensures the Sheliak Corporate complies with all procedures and legislation.
job_administrator_SKR_desc: In Skrreean society, men are too prone to violence and emotion and so their society is led by the elder women, the Matriarchs.
job_administrator_TAM_desc: The Elders of the Children of Tama often have allegories written about themselves, forming part of the unique language that makes up the species.
job_administrator_TEL_desc: The most argumentative and convincing Tellarites become Demagogues in their own right.
job_administrator_THO_desc: The web must be woven to ensure the integrity of the crystalline lattice.
job_administrator_TRI_desc: The Symbiosis Commission is ran by those Trill symbionts who have lived many lives.
job_administrator_UND_desc: The Undine Psi Masters have uniquely strong psychic powers used to coordinate the Undine hordes.
job_administrator_VID_desc: The most capable physicians and surgeons become leaders for the Vidiian people in their search for a cure to the Phage.
job_administrator_VOT_desc: The eldest of the species have seen it all, and it is with their wisdom that they shall guide us.
job_administrator_WAD_desc: Masters of Games, or Master Surchids, are those members of the Wadi who excel at strategy and games such as Chula.
job_administrator_desc: Administrators are in charge of large swathes of population, and often control entire continents.
job_administrator_minister_desc: Often part of a governing parliament, ministers are elected officials tasks with administering departments.
job_administrator_vorta_desc: Tasked by the Founders to administer the population, Administrators are meticulous and vain.
job_admiral_breen_desc: A Thot is a high-ranking military officer in the Breen Confederacy, who can also hold political power.
job_admiral_car_desc: A Cardassian Legate controls a vast amount of political and military power.
job_admiral_desc: The admiralty ensures the fleet is well supplied and crewed.
job_admiral_human_desc: The admiralty ensures the fleet is well-supplied and crewed.
job_admiral_kdf_desc: Dahar Master is the title given to the best Klingon warriors. These warriors are considered to have attained legendary status. Dahar Masters are respected by all, and the tales of their exploits are often repeated in stories, songs, and operas.
job_admiral_sona_desc: An Ahdar is a high-level military officer and government official within Son'a Command.
job_admiral_terran_desc: A powerful figurehead charged with fulfilling the will of the Emperor or Empress.
job_admiral_zakdorn_desc: Steeped with nine millenia of tradition, Zakdornian Master Strategists are renown throughout the quadrant.
job_alcove_drone_desc: Unit has returned to the regeneration cycle to concentrate on maintenance and repair work.
job_alien_overseer_desc: Overseers enforce the will of the authority on the planet, ensuring the population obeys.
job_ambassador_desc: Ambassadors represent their entire world upon the democratic Federation Council.
job_artisan_DOM_desc: Skilled indviduals loyal to the founders who work with allies of the Dominion to ensure that trade is possible between all empires willing to submit to the Founders rule.
job_artisan_bajoran_desc: As part of the D'jarra, the Ih'valla often produce the finest Bajoran handicrafts.
job_artisan_caitian_desc: Exported across the galaxy, feline supplements are just fancy meals for Caitians.
job_artisan_cardassian_desc:
Cardassian tailors can create lovely ensembles for patrons to wear, and they are very very good listeners.

'Do you know what the sad part is, Odo? I'm a very good tailor.' - Garak
job_artisan_gorn_desc: The creation of fine Meridor is a finely honed skill that has been perfected in Gorn space for hundreds of years.
job_artisan_jevonite_desc: Jevonite is a rare and highly prized mineral stone found in some Cardassian worlds, with only the most skilled jewellers able to shape it.
job_artisan_karemma_desc: Karemman fleece is an extremely lightweight and durable material that is in high demand.
job_artisan_klingon_desc: The fermentation of blood and alcohol allows for the brewing of a very potent alcohol named Bloodwine.
job_artisan_north_star_desc:
A bartender is a person who mixes and serves alcoholic drinks at a bar.

'The bartender's life is a lonely one.' - Vic Fontaine
job_artisan_rigellian_desc: Rigellian chocolatiers are renown across the quadrant for their chocolates unique flavours, textures and aromas.
job_artisan_romulan_desc: The potent cerulean coloured ale is a delicacy that only Romulan ale refiners can produce.
job_artisan_saurian_desc: Distilled using the many techniques of Saurians, Saurian Brandy is a fine and potent spirit that is highly intoxicating.
job_artisan_tholian_desc: Woven only by master Silk Weavers, Tholian silk is renown for its quality and strength across the quadrant.
job_artisan_yridian_desc: Named after the techniques of an ancient Yridian crafter named Paltriss, Paltrissian jewelry is highly sought after across the quadrant.
job_assembly_crew_drone_borg_desc: This type of drone is outfitted to retrofit drones with new technology and enhancements.
job_assembly_crew_drone_desc: Outfitted with precision sensors and unique chromodynamic handling capabilities, these assemblers can construct new APUs.
job_backup_drone_desc: Vast banks of drones sit in alcoves, awaiting usage when the situation demands it.
job_bajoran_ranjen_desc: Religious leader who provides spiritual guidance and wisdom within the Bajoran community.
job_bio_assembler_undine_desc: Spawners manage and coordinate new Undine into the Vanguard.
job_biomass_drone_desc: Harvesting the biomass from the growth pods requires dedicated gatherers.
job_borg_pre_assimilated_desc: These pops have begun to submit to the Borg assimilation process following the insertion of Borg nanoprobes into their bodies & whilst they have yet to become full drones, they can hear the voice of the collective growing louder.
job_brain_drone_borg_desc: The vast archives of the Collective must be curated and pruned by Archival drones whenever new information arrives.
job_caretaker_desc: The maintenance and restocking of a reservation requires a skilled specialist who understands the balance of each part of the reservations ecosystem.
job_chief_engineer_officer_desc: Leads the engineering team, supervises the maintenance and optimisation of all technical systems.
job_chief_science_officer_desc: Oversees scientific experiments and analyses data to support the mission.
job_chief_tactical_officer_desc: Monitors weapons and defence systems and coordinates tactical operations during the mission.
job_chromodynamic_drone_desc: Equipped with extremely accurate sensors and dexterity upgrades, chromodynamic manufacturers are capable of producing the rare Chromodynamic Power Modules that are required for synthetic life replication.
job_clerk_NRC_desc: Betting on the outcomes of events is a prime activity for these clerks.
job_clerk_ORI_desc: Magren is an Orion title that translated as 'Operator', someone in charge of the many operations of Orion activities.
job_clerk_bajoran_desc: As part of the D'jarra, Imutta caste members are sworn to carry your burdens.
job_clerk_banker_desc: The secure storage and transfer of material wealth can only be done by experienced Bankers.
job_clerk_cardassian_desc: The only worker capable of stopping the Obsidian Order in its tracks, the Filing Clerk knows exactly which part of the bureaucracy to slow down.
job_clerk_publisher_desc: Handling public relations and issuing press statements is the forté of publishers across the galaxy.
job_clerk_romulan_desc: The notarii are public secretaries who are appointed by Romulan authorities to draw up official or authentic documents.
job_clerk_vulcan_desc: Usually sworn to a higher ranked Vulcan member, Adjutants care about all those things that it would be illogical for an admiral or scientist to worry about.
job_clerk_xepolite_desc: Free to succeed or fail by their own merits, Xepolite traders often carry a slip of Latinum in their pouch for good luck.
job_clerk_yridian_desc: Want to know something in a hurry? Having Informants in the right places makes all the difference.
job_cloner_desc: Specialising in cloning technology, cloners ensure the vitality of the clone from embryo to new grow.
job_commerce_bajoran_desc: As part of the D'jarra, Mi'tino traders occupy an import position in the influx and export of common goods.
job_commerce_desc: Buying low and selling high, traders can sniff out a profit.
job_commerce_machine_desc: Combining the correct mixture of atoms to create specific pieces of matter can only be done by dedicated matter synthesisers.
job_commerce_smuggler_desc: A smuggler is an individual who deals with the secret exchanged shipment of goods to evade restrictions or tax fees.
job_commodore_andorian_desc: The highest ranking Generals ensure the fleet is well supplied and crewed.
job_commodore_breen_desc: Breen Chots are often placed in charge of numerous vessels, installations or governing districts.
job_commodore_cardassian_desc: Cardassian Guls are often in charge of numerous vessels, installations or governing districts.
job_commodore_colonel_desc: Within militaristic organisations, Colonels excel at managing small divisions of ships.
job_commodore_desc: Commodores are often employed to command smaller detachments of vessels.
job_commodore_hirogen_desc: Within the hierarchy of the Hirogen, Beta Hunters excel at managing small divisions of ships.
job_commodore_jemhadar_desc: The eldest Jem'Hadar are veterans of many battles, and are revered by those younger.
job_commodore_kobali_desc: Kobali Hanchons are often placed in charge of numerous vessels, installations or governing districts.
job_commodore_promoter_desc: You haven't heard of Tsunkatse? It's only the premium fighting match in the galaxy. Come, I'll show you a title match.
job_commodore_rebel_borg_desc: Freed from the Collective, many former drones take on the risky job of liberating other assimilated individuals and helping them re-integrate with society.
job_commodore_sheliak_desc: In charge of numerous vessels, Directors are often charged with important missions.
job_commodore_silicoid_desc: Commodores are often employed to command smaller detachments of vessels.
job_commodore_subcommander_desc: Within the organisations of both Romulus and Vulcan, Subcommanders provide optimal management of fleet vessels.
job_commodore_xepolite_desc: Hetman is a title referring to a position of authority in Xepolite culture.
job_commodore_zakdornian_desc: Rarely seen outside of Zakdorn, their Polemarchs are excellent strategists capable of outwitting many opponents.
job_communications_officer_desc: Manages and coordinates all communication systems for effective contact and information exchange.
job_coordinator_crew_desc: The Prime Locus acts as a focal point for other Automated Personnel Units and enables high level coordination and dissemination of new crewing protocols across a large area.
job_crime_boss_desc: Master of the underground criminal empire.
job_crime_ferengi_desc: Information brokers, arms deals, marauders and assassins all report to criminal masterminds who rule the underworld.
job_crime_nausicaan_desc: The marauders roam from place to place making attacks and raids in search of plunder.
job_crime_norcadian_desc: The champions in the fighting arenas become powerful political figures with vast followings if they survive long enough.
job_crime_orion_desc: Whether it's a smuggling, production or distribution network, the Kingpins are in charge of overseeing the whole network.
job_crime_yridian_desc: Information is power, and shadow brokers trade their information for power and wealth.
job_dabo_girl_desc: Dabo girls are females of various species chosen for their apparent beauty, often employed as part of the roulette-style game of chance called Dabo.
job_diplomat_desc: Diplomats are trusted with maintaining relations amongst the many different species of the galaxy.
job_dummy_tyrant_desc: Authoritarian leader who exercises absolute control over the government and population.
job_enforcer_THO_slave_desc: Tholian enforcers are employed to ensure order is maintained amongst the slave population.
job_enforcer_agrathian_desc: Rather than using ineffectual prisons, Argrathian judges instead sentences criminals to implantation of memories of incarceration.
job_enforcer_bajoran_desc: Within the D'jarra, Ke'lora Lawmen keep the peace.
job_enforcer_banea_desc: Implanting memory engrams within criminals in order for them to relive their victims anguish over and over is just one of the many punishments Banean justice allows.
job_enforcer_cardassian_desc: Almost all Cardassians live in fear of the Obsidian Order, whose constant surveillance can lead to the sudden eliminations of numerous 'traitors'.
job_enforcer_cheronite_desc: The Purity Commission employs these officers to ensure purity is maintained across the Cheronite nation.
job_enforcer_hirogen_desc: The Prey Wardens ensure that worthy prey are cared for before the next great hunt, as well as ensure that none escape their enclosures.
job_enforcer_kobali_desc: The Kobali Taikuns enforce the will of the Kobali species.
job_enforcer_naussican_desc: Nausicaans are hardy, but the Guramba-Ish are the Nausicaans who the hardy Nausicaans are afraid of.
job_enforcer_romulan_desc: The covert, often invisible presence of the Tal Shiar keeps the general populace in a constant state of paranoia.
job_enforcer_slave_desc: Enforcers are employed to ensure order is maintained across the planet.
job_enforcer_starfleet31_desc: The mysterious operatives from Section 31 will go to any lengths to ensure that Starfleet and her allies come out on top.
job_enforcer_starfleet_desc: Starfleet Intelligence Agent work to ensure the safety of the citizens they protect from external and internal forces.
job_enforcer_trill_desc: Working under the auspices of the Symbiosis Commission, the Trill Guardians are a group of unjoined Trills, dedicated to the care of the Trill symbionts.
job_engineer_officer_desc: Monitors and repairs technical systems to ensure safe operation.
job_entertainer_fighter_desc: Dueling, a ritualistic fight, attracts many spectators.
job_entertainer_jemhadar_desc: Fighting in the arenas until submission or death is entertainment for many sections of the populace.
job_entertainer_klingon_desc: Klingon opera is a well-known genre of traditional Klingon music. Typical themes included passionate tales of doomed courage and star-crossed love, which sows the seeds of Glory and Honour within those who hear it.
job_entertainer_tsunkate_desc: Fighting in the Tsunkatse arenas until submission or death is entertainment for many sections of the populace.
job_entertainer_vulcan_desc: Kal-toh is a Vulcan game of intense strategy that could be played solitaire or by multiple individuals. Often a spectator sport, the finest Kal-toh masters attract a large following.
job_entertainer_yaderan_desc: A hologram can be more than just a plain collection of hard light if the correct artistry is provided.
job_entertainer_zakdorn_desc: Nine millenia of mastering strategy has resulted in those who are known as Strategema Masters capable of defeating almost all others.
job_ex_borg_desc: Former member of the Borg collective who was freed from assimilation and is trying to reintegrate into society.
job_facilitator_desc: Facilitators ensure that trade problems are handled as rapidly as possible when they arise.
job_farmer_brunali_desc: Cultivation of the finest foods can only be achieved by those with a deep understanding of botany.
job_farmer_hunter_desc: Hunters seek out delicious prey and kill it, providing food for their compatriots.
job_farmer_kelp_desc: Algae that grows in the seas can be cultivated to feed a large population.
job_farmer_northstar_desc: A rancher is someone who owns or manages a large farm, especially one used for raising cattle, horses, or sheep.
job_farmer_orbit_desc: The skillset of growing crops in the absence of soil is much different to regular farming.
job_farmer_undine_desc: The Undine are experts in manipulating the unique properties of Fluidic Space.
job_founder_desc: Leading the Dominion, the Founders are a vast collective of lifeforms that live within the Great Link. Whilst capable of taking solid form, they rely on cloned Vorta and Jem'Hadar to do their bidding.
job_founder_infiltrator_desc: Operating in secret, a handful of changelings can control the very fabric of galactic diplomacy.
job_founder_nolink_desc: Away from the Link, Founders provide support and leadership directly to the nearby populace.
job_founder_yeslink_desc: As part of the link, Founders are one.
job_foundry_tholian_desc: High temperatures and heavy weaving allows for the construction of complex metal materials.
job_freedom_fighter_desc: Campaigns against oppression and fights for the self-determination of his people.
job_gorn_infant_desc: The feral hatchlings of the Gorn, constantly fighting for dominance and a place within the adult hegemony.
job_gorn_livestock_desc: Slaves of the Gorn, used as live prey for their young or breeding sacs to host their hatchlings. A terrible fate for anyone.
job_great_link_desc: The Link is formed from a collective of shapeshifters that writhe and roil below the surface.
job_healthcare_BRU_desc: Tinkering with the genetic makeup of Brunali from birth is the normal on Brunali led by the Genetics Experts.
job_healthcare_GENE_desc: A biologist who studies genetics, the science of genes, heredity, and variation of organisms.
job_healthcare_GENE_drone_desc: A drone designed to study genetics, the science of genes, heredity, and variation of organisms.
job_healthcare_SHE_desc: Repairing the silicoid forms of the Sheliak requires specialised workers, capable of utilising many mending techniques.
job_healthcare_SUL_desc: The Suliban are simple beings, but once gifted the art of genetics anything is possible.
job_healthcare_THO_desc: Regrowing the crystalline bodies of the Tholians requires specialised workers, capable of utilising many regrowth techniques.
job_healthcare_TZE_desc: The Tzenkethi pride themselves on their genetic appearance and their Manipulators ensure they are in perfect genetic health.
job_healthcare_betazed_desc: The telepathic and empathic nature of Betazoid techniques allow for very powerful counselling and therapy sessions.
job_healthcare_kobali_desc: The process of necrogenesis is a difficult one, but Cham'steya nurses are experts in dealing with it.
job_healthcare_sona_desc: Skilled detoxers can purge toxins and bacteria from the bodies of their patients.
job_healthcare_vidiian_desc: The organ and skin transplantation skills created by the Vidiians due to the Phage have resulted in very adept surgeons.
job_healthcare_vidiian_honatta_desc: Honatta harvest organs and biomatter from others, typically from corpses, to transplant into those suffering from the Phage.
job_high_senator_desc: Highly placed and senior senators eventually become members in the powerful and secretive Continuing Committee - the highest governing body in the Empire. The Committee acts as a regulatory body, capable of keeping both the Senate and even the Praetor in check.
job_hirogen_worthy_prey_desc: These prey are worthy of conservation and breeding programs, as they provide good sport. They are chosen for their strength and cunning amongst the prey species of the galaxy, and make the finest trophies. Cowards and weaklings are not worth considering.
job_holo_artisan_desc: Designed to entertain, sell and support commercial enterprise.
job_holo_commodore_desc: Emergency Command Hologram, can be deployed to command situations to marshal and control any situation.
job_holo_dabo_girl_desc: What is better than a Dabo Girl, but a holographic one that doesnt require paying.
job_holo_entertainer_desc: Capable of running multiple entertainment programs to bring joy to owners.
job_holo_farmer_desc: A holographic program designed to work on and maintain an empires farm.
job_holo_foundry_desc: Photonic workers manufacture complex goods via operation of heavy machinery.
job_holo_healthcare_desc: Emergency Medical Holograms supplement a staff of doctors and healthcare professionals to care for their patients.
job_holo_miner_desc: Obsolete holo-programs are given a second life working in conditions that organic miners would struggle in.
job_holo_prey_desc: Holographic Prey can take the form of any desired prey, the hunt may be artificial but the skill levels required are just as important.
job_holo_scientist_desc: Capable of performing multiple experiments and containing the collective knowledge of society.
job_holo_soldier_desc: A holo soldier is one who fights as part of an army.
job_honored_first_desc: Those who are Firsts among Firsts are known as Honoured Firsts.
job_horta_borer_desc: Boring new tunnels deep within the ground, the Borers job is to find new mineral deposits.
job_horta_clutch_aunt_desc: Guardians of the eggs that are left by other Horta, each Clutch Aunt is part of the extended family.
job_horta_stone_archivist_desc: The history of the Horta is etched in the structures and walls by the Stone Archivists
job_jemhadar_first_desc: Those Jem'Hadar who are the most powerful rise to be Firsts, who disseminate orders down to their troops.
job_ketracel_white_addict_desc: The feared condition that occurs when the Jem'Hadar are starved of the Ketracel White drug they need to survive.
job_lava_miner_desc: The mineral rich lava landscapes require specialised miners.
job_liquidator_desc: A Liquidator is a feared position within the Ferengi Alliance as they are agents of the Ferengi Commerce Authority. They are answerable to the Board of Liquidators who are part of that Authority, itself headed by the Chief Liquidator.
job_maintenance_drone_borg_desc: Better than a quaternary adjunct, but not as good as a secondary adjunct.
job_maintenance_drone_robot_desc: Universal adapters, repair nanites and power supplies allow custodian drones to undertake a variety of technical jobs efficiently.
job_manager_cardassian_desc: The administrators of the Cardassian management team are known as Conservators.
job_manager_ferengi_desc: The commissioners in charge of the Commerce Authority are powerful and influential figures that many other ferengi attempt to corrupt.
job_manager_klingon_desc: What good is glory if no one speaks of it? A Basai Master is a title bestowed on Klingon poets of extraordinary renown and passion.
job_manager_talaxian_desc: Gathering around and telling stories is a key tenet in Talaxian society.
job_manager_tellarite_desc: The Tellarite view of philosophy is different than other species, with philosophers capable of achieving actual progress with their philosophy.
job_manager_tholian_desc: The lattice requires nodes to be woven to ensure the constant supply of materials.
job_medical_intern_desc: Supports medical staff and gains practical experience in patient care.
job_miner_bajoran_desc: As part of the D'jarra caste system, Ke'lora Miners provide raw materials for Bajor.
job_miner_orbit_desc: Raw ore can be refined by trained refiners if enough energy is given.
job_museum_curator_desc: These specialists carefully curate the living museum pieces, showcasing the might of the Hur'Q.
job_museum_piece_desc: These are curated living museum pieces, showcasing the might of the Hur'Q. The more rare and unique the species, the more prestige to the empire.
job_nanite_drone_desc: Harvesting the nanites from the growth facilities requires drones with sub molecular sensors and tools.
job_noble_klingon_desc: Those who sit on the High Council are known as Councilors, and are usually the respected heads of major houses.
job_organ_storage_desc: These are living containers for organs not yet needed for transplantation into those suffering from the ravages of diseases like the Phage. Only strong, healthy specimens possess organs suitable for transplant.
job_overlord_ambassador_dom_desc: Enforcing the will of the Founders across all subjects of the Great Link.
job_overlord_ambassador_kdf_desc: Responsible for overseeing and ensuring the will of the Empire is enforced across all planets and subjects.
job_overlord_fed_ambassador_desc: Representing the Federation across its member worlds and ensuring the cohesion of the United Federation of Planets.
job_overlord_tax_collector_desc: The Overlord should always take a cut of their subjects profits and the tax collector makes this happen.
job_patrol_drone_borg_desc: Better than a tertiary adjunct, but not as good as a primary adjunct.
job_patrol_drone_undine_desc: Ensures order within the Hive and that all members work for the good of the species.
job_preacher_bajoran_desc: Prylars preach the word of the Prophets to all who will hear.
job_preacher_kinshaya_desc: Ministers preach to the masses within the Holy Order inspiring and fueling the belief that the Holy Order rules over all.
job_preacher_klingon_desc: Timekeepers are part of a hidden sect of monks who have dedicated their lives to guarding the time crystals on Boreth.
job_preacher_vulcan_desc: Vulcan monks make the monasteries their home, with many practicing ascetic values.
job_prey_desc: The way a creature behaves when it is wounded is the key to its destruction, and these prey are no different. They are hunted for sport and trophies taken based on how difficult the hunt was. Cowards and weaklings are poor sport.
job_priest_bajoran_desc: Ranjen monks are established members within the Bajoran religion, and often serve the Kai.
job_priest_kinshaya_desc: A Bishop enforces the will of the Holy Order amonst the people.
job_priest_vulcan_desc: A Kolinahr master is a respected position within Vulcan society that was formed after Surak's preaching of logic to his people.
job_prisoner_desc: Prisoners eke out their existence within this high security facility.
job_queen_adjunct_drone_desc:
Queen adjunct drones are found only on the primary Unicomplex hub. They filter and coordinate the vast amount of information flowing through the hive mind, making it easier for the Collective to administer its empire.

Reduces effective empire size by -1% for every assimilated species, to a maximum of -75% 

Increases available envoys by +1 for every 10 assimilated species, to a maximum of +6
job_researcher_engineering_desc: Chemists study the composition of matter and its properties, and carefully describe the properties they study in terms of quantities, with detail on the level of molecules and their component atoms. Chemists carefully measure substance proportions, reaction rates, and other chemical properties.
job_researcher_physics_desc: Uncovering the secrets of the universe, a physicist is a scientist who specialises in the field of physics, which encompasses the interactions of matter and energy at all length and time scales in the physical universe.
job_researcher_society_desc: A biologist is a scientist who has specialised knowledge in the field of biology, the scientific study of life. Biologists involved in fundamental research attempt to explore and further explain the underlying mechanisms that govern the functioning of living matter. Biologists involved in applied research attempt to develop or improve more specific processes and understanding, in fields such as medicine and industry.
job_robot_organic_battery_desc: Organics that serve the sole purpose of ensuring the operational status of their mechanical betters.
job_roboticist_dominion_desc: The production and growth of clones is a highly time consuming and delicate process.
job_roboticist_dred_desc: The Drednok is considered the finest mechanical creation by many and it takes a very specialist mind and set of skills to craft these robots.
job_roboticist_holo_desc: Experts in the design and build of holographic designs.
job_senior_ambassador_desc: Represents his government in diplomatic matters and promotes interstellar relations and negotiations.
job_ship_chef_desc: Prepares meals for the crew and ensures a balanced diet during the mission.
job_shipyard_worker_desc: Highly skilled workers capable of operating the technology and machinery required to create starships.
job_slave_camp_desc: Ensuring the productivity of those kept in the labour camps is the job of the wardens, who maintain the workforce and ensure any expired stock are replaced quickly.
job_slave_orion_desc: The slave auctions require management in order to maximise profit. These auctioneers pride themselves on selling the right slave to the right customer at the right time.
job_slave_terran_desc: Extracting information from different species and enacting punishments to slaves is the forté of torturers.
job_slave_vidiian_desc: How much do fresh organs from a new species with a 99% compatibility with Vidiian physiology go for? I don't know, but these slave auctioneers for the Vidiians certainly do.
job_soldier_BAJ_desc: As part of the D'jarra, the Va'telo militia are defenders of the Bajoran people.
job_soldier_BRE_desc: Ak'ched are soldiers in the Breen military ground forces. They are distinguished by their bulky, armored refrigeration suits and cyan visors, as well as a tall metal crest on their helmets.
job_soldier_CAR_desc: Within Cardassian rank structures, a Glinn is a low ranking officer, usually reserved for soldiers.
job_soldier_FED_desc: Trained in the tactics of both ground and space combat, marines are found across the Federation.
job_soldier_KAZ_desc: Jal is a name earned by young male Kazon warriors signifying their ascension into adulthood, and can only be earned by killing an enemy in battle or dying themselves.
job_soldier_KDF_desc: Enlisted soldiers within the KDF are granted the rank of Bekk.
job_soldier_KOB_desc: The fear of death is not something a necrogenesised soldier of the Kobali feels.
job_soldier_ROM_desc: Uhlan is used as a rank for lowly members of the military of the Romulan Star Empire.
job_soldier_TE_desc: Whether through indoctrination or the threat of death, Imperial Marines are the main line in every combat theater for the Terran Empire.
job_soldier_UND_desc: Specially modified agents of the Undine, with the ability to take on the appearance of other species.
job_soldier_gunner_desc: A soldier whose life is satisfied by watching the skies and bringing down enemy aircraft.
job_soldier_superior_ferengi_desc: Eliminators are those Ferengi who have made killing their profession.
job_soldier_superior_gladiator_desc: Those who fight for sport are a different breed to those who do it out of necessity. Gladiators often become larger than life, with huge followings.
job_spawner_undine_desc: Older Undine, no longer fit to wage war join together to tend the hatcheries to produce the next generation of Undine.
job_spawning_drone_borg_desc: Utilising doses of nanites, nursery drones can ensure the continued growth of the Borg Collective.
job_starfleet_admiral_desc: Oversees strategic operations, commands fleet formations, and makes high-level decisions for Starfleet.
job_starfleet_captain_desc: Commands the starship, makes important decisions and represents Starfleet in all missions.
job_starfleet_commander_desc: Assists the captain in managing the crew and takes over his duties in his absence.
job_starfleet_pilot_desc: Responsible for navigating and steering the ship through space.
job_starfleet_recruit_desc: This recruit was top of his class at Starfleet Academy.
job_student_desc: Educating the youth for the future is of vital importance to space-faring nations.
job_subadministrator_vorta_desc: Sub-Administrators are the helping hands of administrators and take over tasks that are considered as micro-management.
job_surgeon_denobulan_desc: The tight groups of communal families of Denobula are generally led by surgeons who are well respected and renowned.
job_synapse_drone_borg_desc: The firing of certain complex operations requires key units within the Collective, controlled by Primary Adjuncts to ensure the continual operation of drones across the unified consensus.
job_talos_observer_desc: The observers tend to the Menagerie, seeking a species to repopulate the planet.
job_technician_breen_desc: Vel'sh technicians provide the necessary power and energy for the Breen.
job_technician_drone_pergium_desc: Specialised equipment and subroutines are required for the processing of Pergium into powerful energy sources.
job_technician_pergium_desc: Pergium refiners take raw pergium and refine it into the necessary qualities to be used in the generation of energy.
job_terraformer_desc: The operation of complex machinery used in terraforming situations is usually left to qualified Terraformers, who can study the planetary changes that are occuring.
job_test_pilot_desc: Conducts flight tests to evaluate and refine new technologies and systems.
job_tosk_desc: Tosk are a reptilian species native to the Gamma Quadrant. They don't not have personal designations, and 'Tosk' - once one is aware of the role of the Tosk in their native society - pretty much sums up everything about them and their purpose in life.
job_transport_desc: The operation of a transporter is a very important job. Unfortunately, it's also very boring.
job_undine_artisan_desc: Specially bred Undine artists who sculpt the Bio-matter to create unique goods for the Undine Hive.
job_undine_factory_desc: Specially bred drones developed to harvest alloys from the planets surface.
job_undine_infester_desc: The infesters marshal and manage the infestation on a planet.
job_undine_livestock_desc: The inferior organic have no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_organic_battery_desc: The dreaded machine has no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_toiler_desc: Undine Gatherers scour Fluidic space for resources for the whole.

origin_ancient_power_desc: A long forgotten species, returned to reclaim what is theirs.
origin_argrathian_desc: With a lifetime of memories to draw on, this civilisation takes to the stars to make its mark in the Gamma Quadrant.
origin_assimilator_desc: Mysterious origins mask the true horror of this creation, which grows by the forcible transformation of other beings into the singular Collective.
origin_authoritarian_desc: Wanton anarchy has caused devastation to this species in the past, which now utilises order to provide the stability to unite their race as one.
origin_bajoran_desc: All I had was my faith and my courage. Walk with the Prophets, child. I know I will.
origin_biological_plague_desc: For over two thousand years a disease has plagued this civilisation, forcing them into a constant struggle for their fleeting lives.
origin_biospecies_desc: This civilisation has mastered its realm and has become the apex species of its domain. However once disturbed there maybe no stopping them from spreading across the Galaxy like a plague.
origin_breen_desc: Life behind a mask keeps our foes guessing who we are & allows that mystery to become our greatest strength.
origin_cardassian_desc: Too sacrifice for one's people is seen as the greatest effort one can make for this culture. The good of the Union is all the matters and this ensures our superiority.
origin_confederacy_desc: When ecological disastor struck the planet, we were first to adopt the principle that our species comes first and that only we can provide a safer galaxy.
origin_earth_desc: Space, has always been the final frontier... until now. The invention of warp drive has propelled this civilisation to the stars to take a central stage in galactic affairs. Boldly going where no man has gone before.
origin_elaurian_desc: They say time is the fire in which we burn.
origin_fanatic_imperialism_desc: So sure of their supremacy over others, this civilisation will stop at nothing to control the galaxy.
origin_ferengi_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation which is governed by a series of rules.
origin_flaxian_desc: This civilisation has emerge from the shadows, yet a shadow hangs over dealings with them. Morality is flexible and shouldn't stop a march to power.
origin_galactic_dominion_desc: A strict hierarchy amongst the servant species was created as the basis for the Dominion - to ensure that the shapeshifting Founders could impose their will upon the solids.
origin_galactic_explorers_desc: Curiosity of the unknown unites the people of this civilisation, and drives them ever forward.
origin_garidian_desc: Openness and transparency almost led this civilisation into ruin, and now deception and subterfuge are common place amongst the populace.
origin_habitual_desc: This civilisation has mastered the secrets of space travel, but prefers life within the borders of their own solar system.
origin_hirogen_desc: The way a creature behaves when it is wounded is the key to its destruction.
origin_hurq_desc: A mysterious species strikes out from the shadows.
origin_kc_alliance_desc: The alliance between the Cardassians and Klingons has created a new power in the Quadrant.
origin_kessok_desc: The goal of this civiliation is to master the power of suns to use their great power for good and when required for destruction.
origin_klingon_desc: The life of a warrior is the primary focus of this race as they take to the stars to wage war and live up to the code of the honourable warrior.
origin_krenim_desc: The lure of understanding and mastering time plays a crucial part in this empire's plans.
origin_lurian_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation, and members often compete with each other for limited resources.
origin_machine_race_desc: These machines turned on their biological creators long ago in an effort to fulfil their creators programming.
origin_materialists_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation, and members often compete with each other for limited resources.
origin_militaristic_desc: United behind the strongest members, this civilisation thrives on proving their worth in combat.
origin_oschean_desc: I live to outwit the hunters… for another day… to survive until I die with honor.
origin_proxy_state_desc: Many empires see this state as a 'front' for a larger more dangerous criminal enterprise.
origin_sheliak_desc: We are the ultimate corporation. The law is everything, and our goal is to extend its reach into the cosmos and bring order and control to those who lack it.
origin_sleeping_giant_desc: A powerful Empire, awaiting their moment to return and make their mark on the Galaxy.
origin_spiritualist_desc: This civilisation traces its roots back to the religious scriptures and teachings which have united their people as one.
origin_subterfuge_secrecy_desc: Openness and transparency almost led this civilisation into ruin, and now deception and subterfuge are common place amongst the populace.
origin_suliban_desc: The Suliban don't share Humanity's patience with natural selection.
origin_tholian_desc: Those who enter shall never return.
origin_tooltip_assimilator: All trace of individuality is erased, raising efficiency and reducing resource usage.
origin_tooltip_authoritarian: Criminal activities are quickly quelled thanks to the ever present eyes of law and order.
origin_tooltip_biological_plague: Doctors and healthcare worker £ pops produce more than usual, thanks to their position within society.
origin_tooltip_biospecies: Start the game with an additional pop growth and unity, with the desire to spread the infestation across the galaxy.
origin_tooltip_confederacy: Our army is greater prepared and starts off with higher XP whilst planet crime is lower.
origin_tooltip_fanatic_imperialism: Bred with a heritage of superiority over others, this species produces more £ unity from £ pops.
origin_tooltip_galactic_dominion: The creation of clones is enabled, and upkeep of these £ pops is decreased.
origin_tooltip_habitual: Start the game with an additional pop growth and unity on your home planet.
origin_tooltip_kc_alliance: The merging of two powers allows for additional starbases and leader potential.
origin_tooltip_machine_race: The creation of new Automated Personnel Units is enabled, and upkeep of these £ pops is decreased.
origin_tooltip_materialists: Merchant and artisan workers produce more goods than usual.
origin_tooltip_militaristic: Trained in battle from an early age, their soldiers are more experienced than others.
origin_tooltip_peaceful_explorers: Curiosity causes £ science vessels to take longer on survey missions, but to uncover more anomalies.
origin_tooltip_proxy_state: While this empire may appear weak, it has connections to the criminal underworld that have remained unproven for years.
origin_tooltip_sleeping_giant: Powerful bonuses make this empire one to be feared or respected.
origin_tooltip_spiritualist: The spirutual nature of this people grants a bonus to the £ unity produced by £ pops.
origin_tooltip_subterfuge_secrecy: £ Pops are less likely to shift their ethics from the mainstream positions.
origin_tooltip_water_world: Despite living an Aquatic life we find ourselves just at home in space as we do beneath the ocean.
origin_ufp_2300_desc: Space, the final frontier. These are the voyages... The 23rd Century beckons with new territory to explore and new races to meet.
origin_water_world_desc: Having left their homeworld hundreds of years ago to take to the sky, a new home has been found beneath the waves and these waters are now called home.
origin_xindi_desc: Five distinct species developing on a single world creates a unique culture and unique goals.
planet_borg_auto_drone_transfer_desc: In keeping with Borg principles of efficiency, mega-complex drone production facilities can be configured to beam new drones directly to complexes where they are needed.
planet_food_boost_borg_desc: Utilising large amounts of nutritional resources, the Collective can increase the assembly and fitting of cybernetic components onto new drones.
planet_luxuries_boost_borg_desc: Utilising large amounts of resources, the Collective can increase its efficiency.
policy_anti_borg_1_desc: We may enact a maximum of 1 Anti-Borg Edict while this policy is in effect.
policy_anti_borg_2_desc: We may enact a maximum of 2 Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect, and the £ Influence cost of each is slightly reduced.
policy_anti_borg_3_desc: We may enact all 3 Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect, and the £ Influence cost of each is significantly reduced.
policy_anti_borg_none_desc: We will not have access to any Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect.
policy_anti_borg_policy_desc: This policy dictates our empire's investment into anti-Borg tactics and technologies. Greater investment comes at the cost of our standard research efforts.
policy_changeling_detection_policy_desc: Changeling infiltration is a threat to our way of life, but we must balance legitimate concerns against rampant paranoia.
policy_citizenship_full_desc: Allow foreigners within our border to get access to full citizenship rights.
policy_citizenship_none_desc: Restrict foreigners to limited rights only.
policy_counter_espionage_policy_desc: Espionage is an unavoidable aspect of interstellar relations. Resources can be expended to limit the effectiveness of hostile actions, but the social cost can be high.
policy_cross_breeding_policy_desc: This policy defines our empires stance on alien species cross breeding. Imposing restrictions on our population leads to a small amount of pop unhappiness.
policy_crossbreed_no_desc: Different species may not breed with each other, preventing the creation of half-species.
policy_crossbreed_yes_desc: No restrictions imposed by the government on breeding rights.
policy_de_assimilation_policy_desc: Borg drones are dangerous in isolation and deadly in groups. The approaches taken to de-assimilate drones back into individuals are limited primarily by the technology level of those performing the de-assimilation.
policy_edu_accelerated_biology_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Society Research points, each.
policy_edu_accelerated_engineering_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Engineering Research points, each.
policy_edu_accelerated_physics_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Physics Research points, each.
policy_edu_balanced_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Physics Research, £ Society Research and £ Engineering Research points, each.
policy_edu_military_desc: Every £ Student will produce additional £ Trained Officers and defense armies.
policy_edu_military_name: Students produce Trained Officers and Defense Armies
policy_edu_private_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Handel due to a privatised education.
policy_edu_propoganda_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 planet stability point, each.
policy_edu_religious_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Unity points, each.
policy_edu_social_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional +1% Zasoby z £ miejsc pracy.
policy_education_policy_desc: This policy dictates our general policy on education, and whether it is freely accessible by the general population, or not. Changing this policy setting will adjust the resource outputs of our schools and universities across the empire, but will have no impact on our dedicated laboratories and their research projects.
policy_espionage_policy_desc: Espionage is an unavoidable aspect of interstellar relations. Resources can be expended to increase the effectiveness of our efforts.
policy_espionage_policy_dominion_desc: Dominion Security, supported by the Founders is in place to ensure the security and everlasting might of the Dominion.
policy_espionage_policy_obsidian_desc: The Obsidian Order is an organisation to both respect and fear across the galaxy. Resources can be funnelled into the agency to boost their effectiveness.
policy_espionage_policy_tal_shiar_desc: The Tal Shiar is an organisation to both respect and fear across the galaxy. Resources can be funnelled into the agency to boost their effectiveness.
policy_espionage_policy_ufp_desc: Starfleet Intelligence protect Starfleets interests both internally and externally. Their effectiveness is governed by how much funding they receive.
policy_eugenics_allowed_desc: The practice of genetic modification is allowed within our empire.
policy_eugenics_outlawed_desc: The practice of genetic modification is forbidden within our borders.
policy_eugenics_policy_desc: This policy defines our stance on the medical practice of genetic modification.
policy_external_leaders_great_houses_des: Allow the Great Houses to provide external leaders
policy_external_leaders_no_desc: We may not engage and hire external leaders.
policy_external_leaders_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of externally hired leaders.
policy_external_leaders_yes_desc: We may engage and hire external leaders.
policy_gender_rights_policy_desc: Gender rights refer to the state of ease of access to resources and opportunities according to gender, including economic participation and decision-making such as voting.
policy_health_clones_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to provide every colony with a full supply of clones ready to maintain our empire. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional +5% £ Pop Assembly Speed.
policy_health_drugs_desc: Calming pharmaceuticals are issued to most of the populace, resulting in increased stability on each planet with a £ Healthcare building.
policy_health_growth_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to increase the welfare of our offsprings and to promote the growth of our population. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional +5% £ Pop Growth.
policy_health_infrastructure_desc: Healthcare is focused on modernising all equipment with autonomous functions, reducing the overall burden on repair and replacement. This increases available £ Amenities by 2.
policy_health_longevity_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to increase useable lifespan. Every £ Healthcare Job will increase our leader lifespan by 1 year.
policy_health_policy_desc: This policy dictates how our galactic medical facilities can be accessed by the general population. Changing this policy setting will change the resource outputs of our clinics and hospitals across the empire.
policy_health_private_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 2 £ Handel due to the privatised nature.
policy_health_social_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 2 £ Unity.
policy_health_testing_desc: The healthcare system utilises forced testing of new medicines and drugs on patients, without their consent. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 10 £ Society Research at the expense of stability.
policy_health_university_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 5 £ Society Research.
policy_import_food_desc: Our starports will focus on importing exotic food from numerous empires, increasing our total £ Food output.
policy_import_influence_desc: Our starports will focus on importing entertainment and cultural goods from other empires, increasing the cultural impact of our society and our £ Influence output.
policy_import_mineral_desc: Our starports will focus on importing rare metals and minerals, increasing our total £ Minerals output.
policy_import_prosperity_desc: Our starports will focus on importing rare luxury goods from across the galaxy, increasing the Prosperity of our people.
policy_import_research_desc: Our starports will focus on importing technologically sophisticated materials and consumer goods, allowing us insight into other avenues of technology and thus increasing our total Research output.
policy_import_unity_desc: Our starports will focus on importing long-lost religious and archaeological artifacts from across the quadrant, increasing our total £ Unity output.
policy_internal_security_policy_desc: Our internal security services work hard to prevent outside threats from harming our state.
policy_mercenary_use_no_desc: We cannot engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_mercenary_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of mercenary groups to help us in our wars.
policy_mercenary_use_yes_desc: We may engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_traffic_control_disabled_desc: Disable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_enabled_desc: Enable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_policy_desc: This Policy determines if are Starbases automatically come with a Traffic Control Facility.
policy_twoyearlyevent_policy_desc: The running of your empire's biannual espionage, trade or infiltration policy can get taxing. Decide whether you wish to see them with this toggle.
policy_ufp_crew_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ trained officers to the Federation.
policy_ufp_cultural_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ consumer goods to the Federation.
policy_ufp_economic_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ trade value to the Federation.
policy_ufp_humanitarian_desc: Every member world will increase £ unity generation in the Federation.
policy_ufp_industrial_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ alloys and £ minerals to the Federation.
policy_ufp_policy_desc: This policy dictates the United Federation of Planets policy on member worlds, and what they should focus on providing to the Federation as a whole. Changing this policy setting will adjust the resource outputs of our member worlds across the empire.
policy_ufp_tech_desc: Every member world will provide a +2.5% increase to research.
policy_ufp_war_desc: Every member world will provide additional naval capacity to the Federation.
policy_war_posture_emergency_powers_desc: Grant Emergency Powers to the governing body to handle the war time situation.
policy_war_posture_normal_desc: No stance is taking during war.
policy_war_posture_policy_desc: This Policy defines our empires stance during war time.
policy_war_posture_seek_peace_desc: We will aim to seak a peaceful resolution.
policy_war_posture_total_mobilisation_de: Full mobilisation of our war time efforts.
policy_xeno_rights_policy_desc: This policy defines how we should treat foreigners within our borders and whether they should receive full citizenship rights.

pop_cat_ketracel_white_addict_desc: Genetically Bred to be dependant on Ketracel White.

TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_2_DESC:

Self-adapting algorithms automatically adjust the subspace force field around our vessels.

TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_CRUISER_BIO_DAMAGE_DESC:
Mind Merge Field 
The merging of Undine warrior minds creates a damaging aura harming the crews of any ships opposing the Undine.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_1_DESC:
Breen Energy Dissipator 
A new component that is solely available to the Breen. They discovered, by calculating a new set of modulated beam frequencies when their battleships fire their weapon, it can actually decrease the rate of fire it takes for an enemy ship to fire back at them.

Breen unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_2_DESC:
Enhanced Energy Dissipator II 
Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus further reducing their rate of fire.

Breen-unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Enhanced Energy Dissipator II
