TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Borg Adaption Synthesisers II
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_3_DESC:
Borg Adaption Synthesisers III 
Your Culture will Adapt to Service us... Resistance is futile.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Borg Adaption Synthesisers III
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_4_DESC:
Borg Adaption Synthesisers IV 
Your Culture will Adapt to Service us... Resistance is futile.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Borg Adaption Synthesisers IV
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_1_DESC:
Adaptive Deflector Field 
The deflector field produced by the navigational array can be adapted to form a protective field across the hull, armouring the structural integrity of the vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_2_DESC:
Neuro-Electric Force Field 
The neuro-electric field is produced by linking drones' lower brain functions together. This allows healthy drones to greatly increase the rate of recovery for injured drones, by neurologically superimposing the correct functioning of damaged components, guiding the healing process. The same technique is applied to our vessels' systems and repair nanoprobes, increasing repair rates.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_3_DESC:
Multi-Regenerative Force Field 
Interlacing force field networks work to reinforce the hull and absorb a portion of incoming weapons fire. Each force field network can only absorb so much damage before the emitters are overwhelmed, powering down to regenerate. When this occurs, another grid activates to compensate.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_4_DESC:
Dispersion Force Field 
Knowledge assimilated from Species 2546 was used to create quantum fluctuation energy dispersers. Fields of quantum flux distortions surround the vessel during combat, disrupting incoming weapons fire. The affected weapons inflict significantly less damage to our vessel's hull.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_5_DESC:
Triaxilating Force Field 
Networks of triaxilating force field generators are installed throughout our vessel. Triaxilating force fields are more resistant to disruptive energy patterns than previous force fields. Additionally, triaxilating waves can support a higher number of interleaving signals, supporting reinforced field geometries.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_6_DESC:
Hyper-Triaxilated Force Field 
It has been noted that the brains of certain species are capable of applying uncommonly accurate heuristics for the task of field adaptations. Drones formerly of these species should be used to guide force field adaptations and to refine algorithms Collective wide.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_7_DESC:
Multi-Triaxilated Force Field 
Multiple sources of triaxilation are capable of applying uncommonly accurate heuristics for the task of field adaptations. Drones of a specific species should be used to guide force field adaptations and to refine algorithms Collective wide.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_8_DESC:
Neural-Coordinated Triaxilating Field 
Drones from Species 226 and 1657 have the ability to apply uncommonly accurate heuristics when attempting to calculate field geometry adaptations for triaxilating force fields. During combat, their brains are interlinked into a computational subnetwork, improving the speed at which they calculate field geometry adaptations.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_9_DESC:
Quantum-Triaxilating Field 
Species 1701 have successfully managed to apply a quantum field around their ships armour. This Technology now services the Borg Collective.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMY_ASSIMILATION_DESC:
Improved Army Assimilation 
Increases the chance of assimilating enemy armies in ground combat by 50% of the base value.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_1_DESC:
Adaptive Plexus 
This plexus has been adapted to facilitate the interlinking of regenerating drones brains into an organic computer core. This is achieved using a short range, super high bandwidth comms node, and the large amount of power available to the drone from the vessel's power grid.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_2_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Plexus I 
The central plexus links each Borg vessel to every other Borg vessel. This facilitates the fast and efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge, and real time tactical data. It also allows each vessel's computer to offload processing tasks to other vessels during times of high demand.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_3_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Plexus II 
Real time subspace communications allow the rapid communication and processing of data during times of demand, resulting in rapid adaptation.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_4_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Plexus III 
Transwarp communications are now possible with a tactical environment allowing processing power from sources as far away as nearby systems to be utilised in the adaptation of new defences.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_CATAPULT_DESC:
Transwarp Aperture 
The formation a stable transwarp stream capable of transporting Borg assets across long distances can be realised via the creation of a new megastructure.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_1_DESC:
Living Metallic Hull 
This vessel's hull is maintained by an armada of trillions of nanoprobes. The nanoprobes and their raw resources are carried around the vessel through artery like conduits. Deformed sections of hull are manipulated at the atomic level to meld them back into shape.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_2_DESC:
Duranium PolyWeave Hull 
A hull formed from polywoven duranium. Duranium is common and tough, making the vessel more damage resistant than previous hull patterns. Polyweaving the duranium allows the repair nanoprobes to effectively manipulate and repair the duranium, without compromising the hull's durability.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_3_DESC:
Paricium Memory Foam Alloy Hull 
This hull is formed from duranium polyweave coated in a protective layer of paricium memory foam. The foam provides excellent shock resistance, while being permeable to the repair nanoprobes to maintain the hull's regenerative ability.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Paricium Memory Foam Alloy Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_4_DESC:
Duranium Buckyball Sheeting 
A hull built from layered duranium buckyball sheets and paricium memory foam. The duranium buckyball sheets provide more kinetic, explosive, and thermal resistance than polyweave. Nanoprobes can rebuild the buckyballs faster than they can repair polyweave threads.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_5_DESC:
Kelindide-Victurium Composite Hull 
Primary hull layer composed of multiple layers of victurium and kelindide. Kelindide is durable but brittle, and so it's supported by layers of the even tougher victurium, which can't be used in large quantities due to several unacceptable properties.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_6_DESC:
Tetraburnium Nano-Weave Hull 
A primary hull layer composed of sheets of tetraburnium alloy woven into nanothreads. The nanothread structure adds incredible impact and shock resistance, while being easier for nanoprobes to repair than solid tetraburnium.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_7_DESC:
Tritanium Mesh Hull 
A tetraburnium nanoweave hull coated in a tritanium mesh. The tritanium mesh is easy to regenerate, and acts as an ablative layer. This helps protect the valuable tetraburnium nanoweave from sustaining damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_8_DESC:
Tritanium Shape Memory Alloy Hull 
Primary hull composed of multiple layers of complementary materials. A fast-regenerating, ablative tritanium mesh is layered over several plates of tritanium shape-memory alloy. The inner layer is formed from incredibly tough tetraburnium nanoweave sheets.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Tritanium Shape Memory Alloy Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_9_DESC:
Victurium Shape Memory Alloy Hull 
Primary hull composed of multiple layers of reinforced materials. A fast-regenerating, ablative Victurium mesh is layered over several plates of tritanium shape-memory alloy. The inner layer is formed from incredibly tough tetraburnium nanoweave sheets.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_9_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Victurium Shape Memory Alloy Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_IMPROVED_ASSIMILATION_D:
Improved Assimilation Process 
By creating new methods to rapidly distribute nanites in the atmosphere, we can greatly speed up the process of assimilating entire planetary populations into the Collective.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_NANITE_ASSEMBLERS_DESC:
Drone-Hive Housing 
Drone Hive districts can now house more drones.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_SPACE_STRUCTURES_DESC:
Hive-like Space Structures 
Unlocks the construction of the space-based structures such as the Unicomplex, Subcomplex, Defenses, and other structures.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_1_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse 
A network of impulse exhaust thrusters that covers the vessel's hull, allowing movement in any direction without having to turn. The decentralised plasma generator node network means that exhaust plasma is equally available for every exhaust.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_2_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array II 
A larger-scale version of the omni-directional impulse drive. Increased quantities of plasma generator nodes, combined with arrays of exhaust nodes, give this engine superior speed and manoeuvrability over the original design.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array II
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_3_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array III 
Improved specification omni-directional thruster array. The primary enhancement is the fitting of a high-gain impulse exhaust array. The increased efficiency boosts the vessel's acceleration, increasing manoeuvrability and cruising speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array III
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_4_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array IV 
An omni-directional impulse thruster array enhanced with a new reactant, avidyne. Plasma fusion nodes use avidyne to produce hotter, denser plasma exhaust, efficiently increasing the vessel's speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array IV
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_5_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array V 
Avidyne-based omni-directional thruster array enhanced with an avidyne-compatible thruster manifold. The heavy plasma turbulence problems which reduced the efficiency of the original design have been fixed, improving performance characteristics.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array V
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_6_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array VI 
An advanced omni-directional impulse drive. Immensely powerful artificial graviton cores project a strong, localised, gravimetric tunnel. The tunnel pulls the vessel through it, accelerating it in the direction of travel.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array VI
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_7_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array VII 
Built from miniaturised assembly segments to form a flexible, compound impulse assembly, this multi-vector thruster manifold provides omni-directional thrust.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_7_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array VII
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_8_DESC:
Omni-Directional Paragravitic Impulse Array 
Dedicated matter-antimatter reactors power the omni-directional impulse field. These small reactors will feed the impulse engines with warp plasma, usually reserved for energising the warp coils.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Paragravitic Impulse Array
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_CETACEAN_CENTRE_DES:
Cetacean Centre 
A location where the brightest minds from the scientific community and the cetacean oceans can come together to work on challenging scientific breakthroughs in navigation, sensors and much more.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_2_DESC:
Advanced Starfleet Intelligence HQ 
Upgraded offices for Starfleet Intelligence Agency, whose mission goal is to protect Starfleet's interests at home and abroad.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_2_TITL: Unlocks Building: Advanced Starfleet Intelligence HQ
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_COE_DE:
Confederation Intelligence HQ 
Headquarters for Confederation Intelligence, whose mission goal is to protect Earth's interests at home and abroad.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_DESC:
Intelligence Agency 
Central offices for the control of internal and external security within the state.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_DOM_DE:
Dominion Security Division 
Central agency for the internal and external affairs of the mighty Dominion. In the name of the Founders.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_S31_DE:
Section 31 Bureau 
Unlocks the property of the mysterious Section 31, who will go to any lengths to protect Federation interests from the shadows.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_STARFL:
Starfleet Intelligence HQ 
Headquarters for Starfleet Intelligence, whose mission goal is to protect Starfleet's interests at home and abroad.
TECH_UNLOCK_CARDASSIAN_EKOOR_DESC:
Ekoor Class 
The Predator of the Cardassian Fleet, hunting in packs to take down larger ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_CARDASSIAN_KULINOR_DESC:
Kulinor Class  
The Kulinor class is a recent introduction within the Cardassian Union's fleet that was made with new advances in technology. They were created secretly by military engineers in order to create a powerful battleship and were known as dark jewels of the Cardassian fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_CASTLE_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Starbase Level V 
The pinnacle of spatial engineering, this starbase is nothing short of a metropolitan anchor in the void. It acts as a central command and control center for entire sectors, capable of fielding vast fleets and coordinating expansive efforts. Its unparalleled resilience and adaptability allow it to project immense power, symbolising dominance and technological might across interstellar distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_CGINDUSTRIAL_DISTRICT_DESC:
Supplies Production 
Industrial districts now increase £ Supplies production by +5% per district.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLONIZATION_BIO_DESC:
Bio-Worlds 
Specially adapted for life in these environments, our race flourishes here. Bio class planets are otherwise inhospitable to non-fluidic life.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLONIZATION_DEMON_DESC:
Demon 
Class Y 'Demon' planets can now be colonised.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_1_DESC:
Spintronic Computer 
Spintronics Computers exploit the intrinsic spin of an electron as a further degree of freedom, allowing for an increase in data storage and transfer.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_2_DESC:
Optical Computer 
Storing information in specially-designed optical matrices, optical computers represent a significant advance in tactical simulation, increasing performance in many ways.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_3_DESC:
Duotronic Computer 
Duotronic computers were designed by the Federation Doctor Richard Daystrom. The technology replaced circuitry that used components such as resistors and transistors.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_4_DESC:
Multitronic Computer 
Multitronic computers utilize very sophisticated technology based on next-level deep neural webs. This allows for a computer that can think and reason, and eventually, even assist in strategy development, ship management and research.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_5_DESC:
Isolinear Computer 
Isolinear chips feature onboard nanoprocessors to aid in memory access and with a maximum capacity of 2.15 kiloquads.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_6_DESC:
Bio-Neural Gel Packs 
Organic circuitry, such as bio-neural gel packs, contained neural fibers surrounded in a blue gel with metallic interfaces on the top and bottom.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_7_DESC:
Direct Synaptic Connection 
Using advanced cortical implants, every member of the crew can access quickly and inutility every facet of the ship controls at any time and from any location.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_1_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array 
These alcoves have been adapted to facilitate the interlinking of regenerating drones' brains into an organic computer core. This is achieved using a short range, super high bandwidth comms node, and the large amount of power available to the drone from the vessel's power grid.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_2_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array II 
The central plexus links each Borg vessel to every other Borg vessel. This facilitates the fast and efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge, and real time tactical data. It also allows each vessel's computer to offload processing tasks to other vessels during times of high demand.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array II
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_3_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array III 
A new model central plexus, updated to handle all communication between the hive mind and the vessel. This allows marginally faster integration of new instructions and data from the hive mind. A range of incremental improvements boost the vessels general performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array III
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_4_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array IV 
The vessel's main computer core is augmented by a matrix of nanoprocessors embedded throughout its hull. The careful manipulation of nearby EM fields loads instructions into the processors via induction. The tiny EM field generated when processing is used to read the result.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array IV
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_5_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array V 
Updated computer cores which are able to interface will all nanoprobes present on the vessel. The nanoprobes take over performing simple calculations, allowing the computer core's advanced processing units to handle difficult computations.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array V
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_6_DESC:
Vinculum 
The vinculum is a powerful neural integration processor, creating the order of the hive mind out of the chaos of individual thoughts. Local integration allows rapid reaction to new events. Each vinculum then sends its local hive mind signature to the queen for integration with the Collective.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_7_DESC:
Interlinked Vinculum 
A vinculum enhanced with the ability to exchange integrated neural patterns with other vinculums, as well as the Queen's unicomplex. This allows a part of the hive mind to be created locally, causing faster adaptations to evolving situations.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_1_DE:
AI Core 
Placing autonomous units' processing nodes into a large network creates a small artificial intelligence network that can be used within our vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_2_DE:
Main Plexus 
Integrating design and processing abilities with a central plexus allows for improved computational abilities.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_3_DE:
Central AI Core 
A central AI core is the heart of a vessel and allows for networked communication between the crew of the vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_4_DE:
High Capacity AI Node 
Larger AI nodes should allow for more automated personnel units to be linked together within our vessels, improving overall efficiency.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_4_TI: Unlocks Component: High Capacity AI Node
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_5_DE:
Distributed AI Network 
By utilising a distributed network where real-time processing is managed directly, whilst secondary routines are shunted off onto low-powered automated personnel units, the efficiency of our vessels' computational power should increase.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_6_DE:
Entangled AI Network 
Following the distributed network, by entangling the artificial intelligence with APU crew, we can ensure a fully real-time computational network.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_7_DE:
Full Entanglement Crew AI Network 
The final step is linking together numerous, automated personnel units in vessels into a fully entangled crew AI network, allowing data to be shared instantaneously, as if that unit had discovered it right then.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_7_TI: Unlocks Component: Full Entanglement Crew AI Network
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_1_DES:
Neural Core 
A neural core is a processing unit that takes the modeled workings of how an organic brain operates and attempts to replicate it.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_2_DES:
Energised Neural Core 
Larger power supplies enable a neural core to undertake more calculations and processes than a regular neural core.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_3_DES:
Organic Computational Node 
Improvements to the growth of organic compounds allows for larger synaptic pathways and processing ability.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_4_DES:
Bio-Pulse Computational Node 
Using pulses of bioenergy, we can simulate the firing of synapses, enabling a short term memory to be created in the organic computational nodes.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_5_DES:
Neural Linked Bioprocessor 
Linking the computational nodes with the crew in an integrated bioprocessor is the next step in organic computational progress.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_6_DES:
Neural Integrated Bioprocessor 
Combining the crew with the neural bioprocessor allows for a vast network to be created across a bioship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_7_DES:
Bio Energy AI Node 
Combining the bioenergy with an artificial intelligence allows for almost sentient computer processing in real time.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_7_TIT: Unlocks Component: Bio Energy AI Node
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_XINDI_1_DESC:
Xindi Hive Mind Interface 
A linked hive like control interface allows a small crew to power a much bigger ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_XINDI_1_TITL: Unlocks Component: Xindi Hive Mind Interface
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ANTI_CLOAK_SCANNER:
Graviton Field Emitter 
Gravitational Field Emitter can be used to detect micro-shifts in the gravitational field around a cloaked vessel.

Metaphasic Sensor Sweep 
A targetted sweep can pickup energy 'distortions', manifesting themselves most often as refracting visible light energy from surrounding stellar objects very near the cloaked ship's outline.

Tachyon Detection Grid 
A tachyon detection grid was a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked warships. The grid used active tachyon beams transmitted between different starships or sentry posts to create a tachyon field.

Quantum Beacons 
These beacons were positron-based, and had an output of two hundred gigawatts. The subassembly tolerances were isolated from the emitter algorithms, which was made possible by generating a stable flux between the positronic conductors and renormalizing the tertiary wave functions.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_1:
Nanite Projector 
Using phased energy beams, nanoprobes are delivered to a vessel's damaged hull segment to begin repair without losing tactical efficiency.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_2:
Nanite Projector II 
With the addition of an advanced targeting node, phased energy beams are able to deliver nanoprobes to the precise location of a damaged hull segment. This allows us to repair our vessels quickly and efficiently.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_3:
Nanite Projector III 
Triaxilating beams focus on damaged segments of hull in order to repair them rapidly and efficiently. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_4:
Nanite Projector IV 
Nanite fields can be projected over large areas of a damaged hull in order to prepare damaged segments. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_TRACTOR_:
Borg Tractor Beam 
A powerful tractor beam utilised by the Borg. It can hold even large ships at bay and also be used in warp.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.

Borg Cutting Beam 
The addition of a cutting beam to the already deadly Borg tractor beam allows the Borg to carve held enemy ships into pieces.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.

Borg Coherent Cutting Beam 
With more power directed at the cutting beam, the Borg can literally carve enemy fleets into pieces.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
Unlocks Component: Borg Coherent Cutting Beam

Borg Focused Cutting Beam 
With multiple emitters allowing the cutting beam to be focused on particularly hardened sections, the Borg can literally carve enemy fleets into pieces.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
Unlocks Component: Borg Focused Cutting Beam

Borg Resonance Cutting Beam 
Resonance technology allows further focus from the beams, giving the Borg more power to cut up anyone who resists.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
Unlocks Component: Borg Resonance Cutting Beam
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BRIDGE_1_DESC:
Battle Bridge 
Redundant command centre for ship activities. It may also be used to command the separate part of an otherwise combined vessel.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BRIDGE_2_DESC:
Fleet Battle Bridge 
An enhanced command centre with communication and control systems enabling superior command over a fleet.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BRIDGE_3_DESC:
Holographic Battle Bridge 
A superior command bridge with holographic displays and communications for full command and control over a large fleet.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_DEFENSE_BATTL:
Exotic Matter 
This unique weapon does not cause actual damage to enemy ships - instead, it infuses their fields with exotic matter, causing them to act unreliably.

This device disrupts the positive auras of enemy ships, rendering them useless in an area around the source.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_DEFENSE_CRUIS:
Anti-Viral Defense 
This dedicated and independent computer module would monitor your ship's hardware and software in real time for any intrusions and interferences from a wide variety of possible enemy devices.

This device makes the ship immune to all form of hostile debuff auras. It may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_DEFENSE_DESTR:
Inertial Nullifier 
This unique device is more than a typical inertial damper. Instead, it's a complex array of backup inertial control device spread out across the ship and linked to highly calibrated gyroscopes. This system allows the ship to resist almost every type of kinetic and spatial form of attack or hindrance.

This device makes the ship immune to all form of hostile snare auras. It may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_1:
Gorn Mk. II Optical Jammer 
A simply jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, this reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. II Optical Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_2:
Gorn Mk. III Gravimetric Jammer 
Gravimetric particles are used to surround a vessel, making it extremely difficult to target accurately.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. III Gravimetric Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_3:
Gorn Mk. IV Subspace Jammer 
Unique to the Gorn, the subspace jammer masks a vessels energy signature within a subspace field, making it extremely difficult to detect.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. IV Subspace Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_4:
Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer 
Unique to the Gorn, the Holographical Spoofing Jammer creates hard light imagery to fool even the most detailed sensors.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_HOLOGRAPHIC_D:
Holographic Ship Projector 
A combination of visual projectors, sensor modifications, and replicator technologies.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_JAMMER_1_DESC:
Signal Jammer 
This basic signal jammer might be based on pre-warp technology, but it is still quite effective. It floods the battlefield with white noise on all electromagnetic spectrum frequencies. The result drastically reduces the accuracy of enemy weapons.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_JAMMER_2_DESC:
Gravimetric Signal Jammer 
Utilising powerful graviton particles in a high powered configuration allows us to use them in our jamming technology used by our vessels.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_JAMMER_3_DESC:
Verteron Overload Jammer 
Utilising powerful verteron particles in a high powered configuration allows us to use them in our jamming technology used by our vessels.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_MINE_1_DESC:
Nuclear Explosives 
Primitive, fissionable, pre-warp nuclear warheads put to use as an orbital explosive.

Every day, the minefield causes an average of between 50 and 100 points of £ Damage to all enemy ships in range. Has a base accuracy value of 50%, and smaller, more agile ships have a higher chance to evade this damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_MINE_2_DESC:
Self-Replicating Mines 
Our researchers have developed a new mine capable of replicating itself. Each mine has initially only 1/65 of the material stored in them for a single replacement mine, but their hive-mind can link and share resources.

Every day, the minefield causes an average of between 110 and 220 points of £ Damage to all enemy ships in range. Has a base accuracy value of 80%, and smaller, more agile ships have a higher chance to evade this damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_1_DESC:
Field Repair Depot 
A component that, when installed on a battleship's bridge, will function as a field repair depot for nearby ships.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_2_DESC:
Mobile Repair Depot 
A component, when installed on a battleship's bridge, will function as a repair depot for nearby ships.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_3_DESC:
Nano-Repair Bots Injectors 
Nano-repair bot pods can be injected directly over the hull of nearby ships, thus increasing the repair rate.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_1_DESC:
Extended Shields 
Allows the battleship's shield emitters to project a shield at a greater distance from the ship to be used to help re-energize the gravitons in other friendly ships' shields if the frequencies match.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_2_DESC:
Rotating Extended Shields 
Enhancements to the battleship's shield emitters' modulation enables better re-energization of allied ships' shields.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_3_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Shields 
Enhancements to the battleship's shield emitters' modulation enables better re-energization of allied ships shields.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_DRAIN_:
Aceton Assimilator 
These devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.

Miniaturised Aceton Assimilator Mk. II 
These devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
Unlocks Component: Miniaturised Aceton Assimilator Mk. II

Comatizer Mk. III Assimilator 
A cunning improvement over the Aceton, the Comatizer can leach even more energy from the shields of nearby vessels.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
Unlocks Component: Comatizer Mk. III Assimilator
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_1_DESC:
Warp Inhibitor 
This system delays the ability of opposing vessels to easily engage their warp drives.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_2_DESC:
Isolytic Subspace Weapon 
A range of directed isolytic energy weaponry with great effect on subspace which is known for causing subspace tears. The weapons either fire energy pulses or beams of subspace wavelengths, or impact subspace directly causing sub-spacial vibrations.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_3_DESC:
Temporal Shockwave Snare 
By creating an chronometric burst in normal space, we can tear a hole in space-time rendering warp drives inoperable for a period of time.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_4_DESC:
Temporal Shockwave Snare 
The isolytic tears in subspace can now be detonated, causing a temporal shock wave which will disable warp drives for a large period of time.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SWEEPER_DESC:
Mine Sweeper 
A powerful suite of short-range, high-resolution sensors, this device allows the ship to detect even stealthed mines before it's too late.

This device gives the ship total immunity from mine damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_1_DES:
Tholian Web 
The tholian web is composed of a series of energy filaments which are generated in a web pattern around a target vessel.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_2_DES:
Tholian Web Spinner 
This module allows the creation of the energy filaments used in the Tholian Web.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_3_DES:
Tholian Web Spinner II 
This module allows the creation of the energy filaments used in the Tholian Web.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_3_TIT: Unlocks Component: Tholian Web Spinner II
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_4_DES:
Super-Luminal Web Spinner 
This module allows the creation of the energy filaments used in the Tholian Web.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_1_DES:
Grappler 
The grappler fires a clawed magnetic Grappler attached to a heavy nanopolymer tow cable that can grapple objects in space.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_2_DES:
Tractor Beam 
A collimated beam of gravitons is used to hold various objects, anything from space debris to a ship.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_3_DES:
Multiphase Tractor Beam 
In order to hold larger objects or non-solid objects, the tractor beam is enhanced with high-surge energy pulses, enabling it to move massive objects, such as stellar core fragments.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_4_DES:
Subspace Tractor Beam 
Remodulating the tractor beams to account for subspace interference allows these tractor beams to hold objects through shields and other obstacles.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.

Bajoran 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Bajoran personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_1_DESC:
EPS Conduit 
EPS conduits take small amounts of plasma and redirect it throughout the ship for use in powering other systems.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_2_DESC:
EPS Manifold 
The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_3_DESC:
EPS Relay 
The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_4_DESC:
EPS Matrix 
With the EPS matrix linked to every system tying them directly in to warp power, systems around the ship gain additional power.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_5_DESC:
Warp Plasma Inflused EPS Relay 
With the EPS relay infused with warp plasma, systems around the ship gain additional power.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Warp Plasma Inflused EPS Relay

Cardassian 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Cardassian personnel.

Chroniton Shielding 
Chroniton Shielding allows a vessel to phase themselves out of time providing near impenetrable shield.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_BACKUP_DES:
Emergency Backup Systems 
The loss of main power can be catastrophic to a starship without the redundancy of emergency backup systems. These allow a stricken vessel the chance to withdraw and fight another day.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_COIL_1_DES:
Backup Warp Coils 
A pair of backup warp coils, ready and primed to enable a quick escape.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_COIL_2_DES:
Auxilliary Warp Coils 
Auxillary warp coils are tied in to the main system, ready to be brought online at a moments notice in case of rapid tactical relocation.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_COIL_DESC:
Backup Warp Coils 
A pair of backup warp coils, ready and primed to enable a quick escape.

Dervish Device 
A console component that uses a sophisticated set of mono-spectrum sub-tools.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_ENGINEERIN:
Main Engineering Console 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is designed to control engineering and will allow our crew to greatly reinforce the structure of the ship's structural integrity field.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_FED_CLOAK_:
Interphase Cloaking Generator 
Light diffusion, and sensor blocking, is further augmented by chroniton particle generation.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_FIRE_RARE_:
Temporal Spitfire 
Cycling temporal energy through the weapons banks drastically increases the rate of cooling available, resulting in a more rapid rate of fire.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_GENERIC_CL:
Early Cloak 
A use of metamaterials, remote-hacking, and radar distortion, that enable one to mask the visual and remote perception of an object.

Spatial Displacement Cloak 
By shifting our ships slightly out of phase with the normal universe, we can shift our vessels to new positions and then reemerge. This will be extremely difficult for our enemies to detect.

Temporal Energy Cloak 
An exceedingly strong cloaking device using chronitons to mask a vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_KDF_CLOAK_:
Invisibility Barrier 
Hiding our vessels has long been a tactician's dream. Our new approach is based on metamaterials, artificial arrangements of resonators with unusual electromagnetic properties which can redirect light.

Raider Prototype Cloaking 
The dampening of external emissions and storage of all waste heat will be required to hide our vessels from sensors.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_LAB_3_DESC:
Stellar Cartography 
Scientific facility with a focus on charting stars and planets. Real-time sensor arrays provide detail on nearby stars, planets, nebulae, and other stellar bodies, allowing ships to investigate anomalies with increased success.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_LAB_4_DESC:
Astrometrics Lab 
Scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale. Large holographic displays can render entire sectors in real-time.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_LAB_DESC:
Multipurpose Labs 
An additional, basic, mobile science lab, designed to deal with a variety of spatial phenomena encountered in deep space.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_ROM_CLOAK_:
Holographic Chameleon 
Holoemitters can hide the true capabilities and shape of our vessels, sowing discord in the opponents ranks.

Multiphasic Cloaking 
Multiphasic sensor masking allows for the masking of many emissions from different sources, thus rendering vessels harder to detect.

Dual Cloaking Generator 
By tying in a large enough power generator with dual shield and cloaking devices, it should be possible to maintain deflector shields whilst cloaked.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_SCIENCE_DE:
Science Console 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is scientific in nature and will provide our ships with increased evasion, tracking, and targeting.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_SPEED_DESC:
Temporal Rewinder 
A console, based on cutting-edge temporal research, it uses a closed temporal loop to create duplicates of our starships for a short period of times.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_TACTICAL_D:
Tactical Console 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is tactical in nature and will allow our crew to safely divert energy to increase the maximum damage of our weapons systems.

Advanced augmentations providing a crew that can work quicker, smarter and more deadly.

Clone

Hunter 
Trained to hunt prey, these hunters are expert raiders.

Husnock 
The violent and brutal Husnock crew this vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_KAZON_DESC:
Kazon 
The aggressive and brutal Kazon make ineffectual explorers, but great warriors.

Kobali 
Kobali crews are made up from the dead of other races.

Sheliak 
The stoic R-3 lifeforms known as Sheliak crew this vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_TELLARITE_DES:
Tellarite 
Filled with ornery Tellarites, these crews are stubborn and stoic.

Voth 
Voth crews ensure that Doctrine is adhered to across the quadrant.

Federation

TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_FERENGI_CASINO_DES:
Mobile Casino 
High rollers from many worlds enjoy visits to these luxurious mobile casinos that traverse the stars away from any prying eyes.

Mobile Casinos produce a small amount of £ latinum, and remember: the House always wins.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_INF_SPAWNER_DESC:
Infestation Spawner 
An additional attachment to Undine stations that allow them to spawn the dangerous Infestation Class Ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_KLINGON_CREW_DESC:
Klingon 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Klingon personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_PROSPECTING_BAY_DE:
Prospecting Bay 
A prospecting bay allows the processing of any small minerals or materials that the construction vessel may come across.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_2_DES:
Tal Shiar Operatives 
Trained to an extremely high standard, and extremely self sufficient, Tal Shiar operatives put the needs of Romulus above all else.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_3_DES:
Reman Crew 
Raised in the dark mines of Remus, these Remans are extremely loyal and dedicated.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_4_DES:
Telepathic Control 
Vessels can be controlled over vast distances via telepathic link.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_DESC:
Romulan 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Romulan personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_1_DESC:
Optical Sensor Array 
Optical telescopes are tried and true pre-warp technology that has allowed us to explore the universe even before we launched our very first space ship. Modern optical sensors are leaps and bounds ahead of those ancient telescopes, but it is still the continuation of a proud tradition.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_2_DESC:
Gravitic Sensor Array 
These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_3_DESC:
Tachyon Sensors 
Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_4_DESC:
Trans-Spectral Sensors 
Research into advanced subspace physics has made it possible to detect tiny ripples which cause slight variability in subspace.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SHIP_AUTOMATION_DE:
Ship Automation Centre 
Added layers of automation that increase efficiency and decreases resource consumption on all ships with it installed.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_AUX_CREW_2:
Crew Quarters II 
Common crew bunks, usually stacked four to a room. Facilities are shared by each bunkroom.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_AUX_EMITTE:
Shield Emitter 
A utility device that generates large field of gravitons for sustained periods of time. These new emitters will increase the regeneration process of our shields.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_LARGE_TRAC:
Cetacean Ops 
Cetacean Ops was a facility aboard Starfleet starships in the late 24th century. They generally contained an aquarium, so as to simulate the natural habitat of cetaceans allowing them to work with the scientists and navigators onboard the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_REACTOR_PE:
PXK Pergium Reactor 
Using rare refined Pergium, this reactor can supply massive amounts of supplementary power when a vessel requires it.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_AGONY_DESC:
Agony Booths 
Agony booths are installed within the vessel, providing a way to dispose of traitorous crew or lacklustre crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_2_DESC:
Dicyclic Life Support System 
A redundant life support system can be built into the vessel, increasing survivability when heavily damaged.

Increases the likelihood of a heavily damaged vessel successfully withdrawing from battle.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_2_TITLE: Unlocks Console: Dicyclic Life Support System
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_3_DESC:
Tricyclic Life Support Systems 
Triple redundant life support systems offer increased survivability to the crew of a stricken vessel.

Increases the likelihood of a heavily damaged vessel successfully withdrawing from battle.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_3_TITLE: Unlocks Console: Tricyclic Life Support Systems
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_4_DESC:
Emergency Command Hologram 
In the event of total crew loss or incapacitation, the emergency command hologram can activate and take over the running of the vessel, ensuring optimum chance of survival or retrieval.

Increases the likelihood of a heavily damaged vessel successfully withdrawing from battle.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_ENGINEERING_2_DESC:
Engineering Station II

This targeting array utilises time-crystals in order to enable precision targeting.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large, standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_CPM_CPM_DISTRICT_DESC:
CPM 
CPM districts now produce more £ CPMs.
TECH_UNLOCK_CREATE_FEDERATION_DESC:
Form Coalition 
Allows us to form a coalition with other Empires.
TECH_UNLOCK_CREW_AI_DESC:
AI Control 
A central AI controls the crew.

Crew 
Administrative districts now recruit more £ Crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_CRIME_MILITARY_DISTRICT_DESC:
Crime 
The Administrative district/Hive Foci now reduces £ Crime.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_ARTIFICIAL_GRAVITY_DE:
Artificial Gravity 
The generation of an artificial gravity field onboard our vessels allows for regular onboard activity without the need of specialised equipment.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_ASSAULT_ARMIES_DESC:
Assault Armies 
The creation of a military body that is capable of traversing space and assaulting other planets requires a substantial investment in training and new research.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_BUREAU_COLONIAL_DESC:
Colonial Management 
The management of more than one planetary body requires new communications and governance protocols to be developed to deal with the vast distances involved.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_CLONE_ARMIES_DESC:
Clone Armies 
Vat-grown clones that reach adulthood in a matter of months. With a natural lifespan of less than a decade, their lack of personal initiative is deemed an acceptable trade-off for their total obedience to officers.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_OFFWORLD_CONSTRUCTION:
Offworld Construction 
The construction of facilities offworld requires a substantial investment in resources and development.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_ARTIFACT_1_DESC:
Permanent Exhibitions 
Allows the permanent exhibition of certain minor artifacts on worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_ARTIFACT_2_DESC:
Artifact Showcase and Trading 
Allows minor artifact showcases and trading.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_ARTIFACT_2_TITLE: Unlocks Decision: Artifact Showcase and Trading
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_BIGGER_ASTEROID_DES:
Hollowed Asteroid 
Hollowing out the internal sections of asteroids could improve the amount of livable space for our larger habitats.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_EXTRACT_METALS_DESC:
Nanite Metal Extraction 
Metals can be extracted from the crust and mantle of a planet via nanites.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_POP_MANAGEMENT_DESC:
Population Management 
The management of vast bodies of the population is a monumental task that requires an iron will.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENCE_FORCEFIELD_2_DESC:
Form-fitting Forcefields 
Generated forcefields that exist just above the surface of the hull, protecting it from near energy bursts and weapon damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_3_DESC:
Advanced Forcefields 
Powerful forcefields cover sections of the ship, providing additional defence against the stresses of space.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_4_DESC:
Structural Integrity Field 
A powerful energy field that covers the interior sections of the vessel, providing a source of energy to bolster the hull against the stresses of space combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_5_DESC:
Rotating Structural Integrity Field 
The rotating frequencies of the structural integrity field grant additional protection from the stresses of combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Rotating Structural Integrity Field
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_6_DESC:
Dynamic Structural Integrity Field 
The structural integrity field can now be shifted across the vessel, providing support in areas that require it most.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Dynamic Structural Integrity Field
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_2_DESC:
Polarised Hull Plating 
Through the application of an electromagnetic field to the ship's hull, the structural integrity can be significantly increased, protecting the starship from enemy weapons fire.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_3_DESC:
Polarised Hull Plating Relay 
Relays situated across the hull allow power to be shunted into sections of the hull, polarising it against energy weapons fire.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Polarised Hull Plating Relay
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_4_DESC:
Trellium Plating 
Trellium plating is used to line the hull, providing increased protection from the dangers of space.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_5_DESC:
Heavy Trellium Plating 
Heavier trellium plating secures the hull, providing substantial protection from the dangers of deep space.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_6_DESC:
Ablative Armour 
An additional layer of hull plating layered on top of the regular hull, which is designed to absorb damage and be destroyed before the true hull plating receives damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_7_DESC:
Ablative Generator 
Technology similar to replicators, this generator can create an nearly impenetrable layer of additional armor outside of the normal hull of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMACY_PATH_DESC:
Diplomacy 
The path of growing diplomatic ties, trade, and trust with foreign empires.
TECH_UNLOCK_DRONE_EXTRA_NAVAL_CAPACITY_D:

TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_1_DESC:
Titanium Hull 
Space-age materials for the first true spaceships of our times.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_2_DESC:
Tritanium Hull 
Applying this new, lighter material to our ships' hulls would make our ships even more durable.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_3_DESC:
Tritanium-Magnesite Hull 
Magnesite is an oxide form of magnesium, one of the lightest metals we have discovered. Its light weight, high toughness, and machinability make it an ideal choice for starship hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4A_DESC:
Electro-Ceramic Hull 
A light material component that can be used on the hull to increase the manoeuvrability of our starships, but due to the lightness of the material it will come at a cost of reduced armour.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4B_DESC:
Kelindide-Magnesite Hull 
By weaving magnesite through the kelindide alloy hull, we have created an even stronger armour that increases the durability of our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4C_DESC:
Duranium-Magnesite Hull 
By weaving magnesite through the duranium alloy hull, we have created an even stronger hull that increases the durability of our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4D_DESC:
Modular Duranium Plating Hull 
Prefabricated hull sections can be combined efficiently and cost effectively. Whilst not strong, nor nimble, the vessels made from these readily available materials are extremely cost effective to operate.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4D_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Modular Duranium Plating Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5A_DESC:
Paricium Hull 
A ceramic alloy, often mixed with Talgonite, used in hull construction. It is light, but comes at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5B_DESC:
Reflective Kelindide Sheeting 
Reflective sheeting on this kelindide based hull provides a slight increase to the armour of the hull.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5C_DESC:
Duranium Weave Hull 
By weaving these two heavy metallic alloys together we have the basis of an even stronger hull that increases the durability of our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5D_DESC:
Parametallic Magnesite Hull 
If we want to make our starships more durable, we could investigate additional materials that can be placed on the external layers of our starship hulls. By combining different types of materials together, we have come up with another type of armor plating. This new type of alloy will provide the additional protection needed against weapon fire or hazardous materials a starship's hull could encounter.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6A_DESC:
Magnesite-Paricium Hull 
A stronger metallic alloy than tritanium that can be applied to our starship hull for an even further increase in the durability of our ships' hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6B_DESC:
Dispersive Kelindide Sheeting 
Improves to the kelindide sheet now disperse impacts rather than reflecting them, providing an increase to the armour rating of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6C_DESC:
Duranium-Victurium Hull 
The implementation of Duranium alloy on our starships have been a monumental success. Now, we just discovered a new metal alloy called Victurium, seemingly just as strong as Duranium and if we combine these two metallic alloys together, we will have the basis of an even stronger hull that further increases the durability of our ships' hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6D_DESC:
Non-Reactive Victurium Hull 
The creation of a hull that is simply non-reactive to energy bursts is a very cost-effective way of providing protection for a vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7A_DESC:
Magnesite-Monotanium Hull 
Monotanium is a metallic alloy that will probably be the lightest type of material we could possibly ever discover. While an extremely light armor component, it will still increases durability.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7B_DESC:
Reactive Kelindide Sheeting 
Blast plates under the kelindide sheeting allow for reactive armour improving the armour rating of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7C_DESC:
Duranium Composite Sheeting 
Duranium is an extremely strong metal that is used by many species for starship hulls due to its suitability as armor. It is heavy though, potentially increasing a ship's mass and making it less maneuverable.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7D_DESC:
Duranide Alloy Hull 
Polyduranide is a metallic material used for construction purposes. It is cheap and easy to mass produce via machinery.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8A_DESC:
Light Magnesite-Tritanium Hull 
Constructed by large amounts of magnesite treated with tritanium, this alloy is light but at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8B_DESC:
Heavy Kelindide-Tetraburnium Hull 
The creation of a heavy Kelindide-tetraburnium alloy that is resistant to energy weapons drastically improves the armour rating of a ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8C_DESC:
PolyDuranium Weave Hull 
Another metallic alloy has been classified and this one we are calling PolyDuranium Weave. Going along the branch of our Duranium and Duranium-Victurium type alloys, this alloy is even stronger than those, providing further increases to the durability of our ships' hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8D_DESC:
Plasticised Tritanium Mesh Hull 
Treating tritanium with cheap, but strong, plastics allows us to create an extremely inexpensive hull material with the strength of tritanium.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8D_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Plasticised Tritanium Mesh Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_9A_DESC:
Light Trititanium-Victurium Hull 
Constructed by large amounts of combined Trititanium-Victurium, this alloy is light but at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_9B_DESC:
Heavy Tetraburnium-Victurium Hull 
The creation of a heavy Tetraburnium-Victurium alloy that is resistant to energy weapons drastically improves the armour rating of a ship.

Sharing similar design traits to the Vorcha and K't'inga class vessels, the Negh'Var is designed to be the flagship of entire armadas of vessels. Its massive crew complement and exceedingly heavy weaponry can compete with entire small fleets by itself.

TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_ANTIMATTERWARHEAD_PRINC:
Antimatter Warheads 
An antimatter weapon is a device using antimatter as a power source, propellant, or explosive, in the case of the theoretical photon torpedo.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_ANTIMATTER_PRINCIPLES_D:
Antimatter 
The principles of antimatter weapons are to utilise devices using antimatter as a power source, propellant, or an explosive.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_DISRUPTOR_PRINCIPLES_DE:
Disruptor 
The basic principles of disruptor technology are that disruptors cause damage by exciting the molecular bonds of targets to such great extents that those bonds are weakened, and/or broken, by the energies emitted, which often manifest as explosive force.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_PHASER_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Phaser 
Phase weapons, or phase-modulated energy weapons, are a type of directed energy particle weapon that utilized a phase modulator to control the blast yield.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_PLASMAWARHEAD_PRINCIPLE:
Plasma Warheads 
A plasma weapon is a type of direct-energy particle weapon that uses plasma as a means of inflicting damage to the target.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_PLASMA_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Plasma Warhead 
The basic principles of plasma technology is that the unstable ionized gaseous state, often used onboard starships to channel power, can be used within warheads which which often manifest as explosive force.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_TETRYON_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Tetryon 
A tetryon is a subatomic particle that can only exist in subspace environments. Since these particles are a property of subspace, they become highly energetic and unstable when they are extruded into normal space, which can occur by both natural and artificial means, such as with tetryonic weapons.

TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_ARGUS_DESC:
Argus Array 
A massive sensor array, the Argus Array consists of eighteen hexagonal subspace antennae clusters, each powered by an individual fusion reactor, and all regulated from a central computer. It is capable of collecting detailed images of objects many light years away.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_BORG_CONDUIT_D:

TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_DAYSTROM_DESC:
Daystrom Station 
Daystrom Station was a Federation space station that served as a high-security black site of the Daystrom Institute.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_FED_MUSEUM_DES:

Higher Chance of Dangerous Techs 
The Think Tank is composed of scientists who come up with new radical ideas to overcome problems. Some of these solutions are less than orthodox.
TECH_UNLOCK_MORE_DANGEROUS_TECHS_TITLE: Unlocks Improvement: Higher Chance of Dangerous Techs
TECH_UNLOCK_MOVING_LINK_DESC:
Moving the Great Link 
The Great Link is a unique and complex biome composed of a countless number of our gods, intertwined. When needed, in times of great effort and secrecy, we can relocate them to create the Link anywhere, on a different planet. Our new home will never be the same.
TECH_UNLOCK_MOVING_LINK_TITLE: Unlocks Megastructure: Moving the Great Link
TECH_UNLOCK_NANITE_NANITE_DISTRICT_DESC:
Analysis 
Analysis districts now produce more £ Nanites.
TECH_UNLOCK_NAVALCAPMILITARY_DISTRICT_DE:
Naval Capacity 
Every military job (Admirals, Commodores and Soldiers) now gains a +1 £ Naval Capacity bonus.
TECH_UNLOCK_NAVALCAP_PER_SOLDIER_DESC:
Increased Naval Capacity 
By setting up their own planetary defenses, military personnel slightly expand the naval capacity of the empire.

Adds +1 Naval Capacity for every Soldier, Enforcer, Commodore and Admiral job.
TECH_UNLOCK_NORCADIAN_ENTERTAINMENT_DESC:
Entertainment 
Our entertainment buildings are more effective now.
TECH_UNLOCK_PARATRINIC_SHIELD_DESC:
Paratrinic Shields II 
Paratrinic shielding is a type of advanced form of deflector shield technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_PHASER_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Phaser Weaponry 
Phasers fire nadions at their target which interfere with the nuclear forces that bind atoms together. Unusually versatile, nadion beams can be adapted for many uses such as heating, drilling, stunning, killing or disintegrating.
TECH_UNLOCK_PHYSRESEARCH_DISTRICT_DESC:
Research 
Research districts now produce more £ Physics Research.

Economics

TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_FOOD_POLICIES_DESC:
Food 
This allows adjustment of the food policy across all the worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPECIALIZATION_FORGE_:
Forge 
Dedication of an entire world over the industrialisation of the surface, where every raw resource is used to produce or manufacture another product.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPECIALIZATION_RELIGI:
Religious 
Ensuring our most sacred worlds are kept as pure as possible is a valuable boon for our species.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPECIALIZATION_RESORT:
Resort Planet 
With much landscaping, a luxurious planet can be designated with recreational accomodations, activities and wonderful scenery. Citizens from many empires covet visiting worlds like this.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_CLONING_DESC:
Cloning 
An entire world dedicated to the mass production of clones created from specific genetic material.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_COMMERCE_DESC:
Commercial World 
The buying and selling of products on a galactic scale requires certain laws, regulations and transactional technology. By creating a world as a freeport for all traders, it can be dedicated to trade, bringing in a large amount of wealth.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_EMBASSY_DESC:
Embassy World 
A neutral ground where citizens of numerous races are allowed to speak, trade and communicate freely.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_FORTRESS_DESC:
Fortress World 
Bristling with turrets, mines, weapons facilities and forges, the fortress is an almost impenetrable world that stands as a bastion against enemies.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_HUNTER_HIROGEN_D:
Hunting World 
Unleashing worthy prey and giving them advantageous terrain to call their own makes the hunt all the more thrilling. By dedicating a world to hunting practices we can ensure our population never strays far.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_MUSEUM_DESC:
Planetary Museum 
The Hur'Q curate entire cultures and civilizations for their own purposes. The creation of a world dedicated to this is an important step for their insectoid minds.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_PENAL_DESC:
Penal Colony 
Prisoners from across the galaxy can be sentenced to a penal colony, removing the requirements for prisons on our worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_RESORT_DESC:
Resort Planet 
With much landscaping, a luxurious planet can be designated with recreational accomodations, activities and wonderful scenery. Citizens from many empires covet visiting worlds like this.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_RETREAT_DESC:
Religious Retreat Planet 
Some worlds have a deeper purpose to certain civilisations, and dedicating these worlds as a religious retreat allows it's natural resources to be preserved.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_RETREAT_TITLE: Unlocks Planet Specialisation: Religious Retreat Planet
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_UNIVERSITY_DESC:
University World 
The whole world, entirely dedicated to research and academic pursuits across a wide variety of fields, will become the hub of science and technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_TRADE_POLICIES_DESC:
Trade 
This allows adjustment of the trade policy across all the worlds.

TECH_UNLOCK_PREDESC_WORD_OF_ALAR_DESC:
The Word of Alar 
The Word of Alar improves the opinion of other races significantly.
TECH_UNLOCK_PREDESC_WORD_OF_ALAR_TITLE: Opinion Improved: The Word of Alar
TECH_UNLOCK_PRIVATE_COLONY_SHIP_DESC:
Private Colony Ship 
Colony ships are single-use vessels for settling on alien worlds. Upon colonization, the ship is scuttled and converted into a planetary shelter and foothold.
TECH_UNLOCK_PRIVATE_COLONY_SHIP_TITLE: Unlocks Ship Type: Private Colony Ship
TECH_UNLOCK_PURGING_POLICIES_DESC:
Purging 
Lesser races can be useful to our industrial complex, though how long they are useful for is a matter of policy.
TECH_UNLOCK_RAWDIL_INDUSTRIAL_DISTRICT_D:
Industrial/Production 
Industrial districts now produce more £ Dilithium.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_1_DESC:
Central Fusion Power Core 
To be able to function in deep space our stations require large power sources. With our understanding of fission we have come up with a reactor that is nuclear in nature which will provide power to our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_1_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Central Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_2_DESC:
Electrostatic Fusion Power Core 
A Electrostatic Fusion Power Core uses an electric field to heat plasma to fusion conditions resulting in the increase in the amount of power we can provide to our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Electrostatic Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_3_DESC:
Carbon Reaction Fusion Power Core 
An upgrade to our Central Fusion Power Core by allowing the nuclear fusion reaction of three helium 4 nuclei generates carbon and oxygen as byproduct on occasion, thereby, releasing this energy in a high temperature plasma, further increasing the power of our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Carbon Reaction Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_4_DESC:
Deuterium Fusion Power Core 
The final upgrade of our central fusion reactors uses pure Deuterium fusion which releases more than four times the energy compared to early stage He3 reactors. By integrating a phase discriminator in the confinement tokamak allows us to pierce the coulomb barrier and to develop a safer, more efficient and powerful fusion reactor for our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Deuterium Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_5_DESC:
Fusion Array Power Core 
A new type of fusion reactor that cascades the phase discriminator field around an array of reactors, thereby decreasing the energy requirements to maintain fusion, thus increasing even more the efficiency and energy output for our station reactors.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Fusion Array Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_6_DESC:
Tetryonic Power Core 
This station reactor uses Tetryon, which is a type of subatomic particle that originates from subspace. By extruding the particle field through different subspace manifolds in a controlled manner, it's possible to extract energy from the shallower subspace strata without the dangers of tetryonic radiation thereby creating a new type of reactor for our stations that has unprecedented power efficiency.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_7_DESC:
Chroniton Power Core 
Harnessing the power of subatomic particles with temporal properties known as Chronitons has enabled our reactors to draw energy from space-time itself. This new type of power core nears the pinnacle of energy generation itself.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_8_DESC:
Decalithium Fusion Power Core 
Using the rare refined Decalithium, this reactor can supply massive amounts of supplementary power when a vessel requires it.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Decalithium Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_9_DESC:
Temporal Power Core 
A temporal core, which kept the vessel out of phase with normal spacetime, thereby protecting it from the changes to the timeline which it initiated.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_XINDI_KEMOCITE_DESC:
Xindi Kemocite Reactor 
The Arboreals produce the finest variaty of Kemocite in the Delphic Expanse and this Kemocite fuels the Weapon and the craft that houses it.
TECH_UNLOCK_REQUIRED_DEFENSE_ARMOR_1_DES:
Deflector Fields 
Deflector fields projected around our vessel protect it from small objects whilst travelling at high velocities.

Research and development centres can now plan for highly specialised ships that are best suited for the task at hand, with additional options in armament and utilities.

Beam Mounts 
This tech dictates us a general design philosophy concerning energy weapons, and whether we prefer beam or cannon mounts. This applies to every military ship in our arsenal.

These sections are available to every civilian ship class.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_1_DESC:
Shields 
The deflector shield is a force field, or generally an energy field, which serves primarily to protect a spacecraft from radiation, attacks or solid bodies.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_2A_DESC:
Covariant Shields II 
Covariant deflector shielding uses multiple interlacing force fields to create a truly resilient solution that are more durable than their counterparts.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_2B_DESC:
